title.zh: 已验证 DSH 插件（dsh.so L4/L5）

description.en: Real, installable DSH plugins only: npm-sourced, gated on a dsh.bundle manifest, and carrying a dsh.so L4/L5 verification and a low-risk security scan. Verification data from dsh.so (https://www.dsh.so, CC-BY-4.0, scanned 2026-10-22T19:43:13.345Z); publish times from the npm registry.
description.zh: 只收真实可安装的 DSH 插件：npm 来源、必须有 dsh.bundle manifest，并带有 dsh.so 的 L4/L5 验证与低危安全扫描结论。验证数据来自 dsh.so（https://www.dsh.so，CC-BY-4.0）；版本发布时间取自 npm registry。

title.zh: dsh.so L5 实机运行验证

description.en: Skill center for the dsh web GUI: browse all loaded skills grouped by source, enable or disable model invocation, create new skills, and delete into a recoverable trash.
description.zh: 技能中心：按来源分级浏览已加载的全部 skill，启用/禁用模型调用、创建新技能、删除进可恢复回收站。

description.en: Remote control of a dsh web workspace from phone or PC: QR-code pairing through a token-gated channel, SSE real-time sync, and separate mobile and full desktop GUI modes.
description.zh: 手机/PC 远程操控 dsh web 工作区：扫码配对、令牌门控通道、SSE 实时同步，提供移动端与完整桌面 GUI 两种远程形态。

description.en: Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar multi-column kanban whose cards run in real DSH agent sessions and can also be scheduled with cron expressions, executed host-side even with the browser closed.
description.zh: 侧边栏多列任务看板：卡片交给真实 DSH 智能体会话执行，支持 cron 定时（Host 侧到点执行，关浏览器也生效）。

description.en: Git branch selector and Git graph for the dsh web GUI: switch branches and explore branch-lane and commit history from the conversation header.
description.zh: 输入框上方提供 Git 分支选择器，并把分支泳道与提交历史画成图谱，沿着时间线找到任意变更。

description.en: SSH ops panel for DSH: web terminal, SFTP transfer with progress, local port forwarding, and one-command cluster execution across hosts; agents share the same host config.
description.zh: SSH 远程运维面板：Web 终端、SFTP 传输、本地端口转发与一条命令并发集群执行，Agent 与面板共用同一份主机配置。

description.en: Plugin and skin collection for the DSH Web UI: task board, Git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, pet, live token stats, and a skin center.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤合集：任务看板、git 图、右侧面板、远程移动端 UI、桌宠、实时 token 统计与皮肤中心。

description.en: OpenViking memory and context bundle for DeepSeek Harness: pre-step auto-recall and profile injection, session capture, `viking://` URI guarding, and recall/write memory tools backed by an OpenViking server.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenViking 记忆与上下文插件：pre-step 自动召回与画像注入、会话捕获、`viking://` URI 防护，以及对接 OpenViking 服务端的 recall/write 记忆工具。

description.en: Generate validated, self-contained interactive architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams from repositories or system descriptions.
description.zh: 从仓库或系统描述生成经过校验的自包含交互式架构图、流程图、时序图、数据流图和生命周期图。

description.en: Local-first code knowledge graph for coding agents: 10 MCP tools for layered context compression, DAG planning, incremental AST indexing, a cross-session skill flywheel, diagnostics, and graph artifact import/export.
description.zh: 面向编程 Agent 的本地代码知识图谱：提供 10 个 MCP 工具，覆盖分层上下文压缩、DAG 规划、增量 AST 建图、跨会话技能飞轮、诊断与图谱产物导入导出。

description.en: BrowserSkill bridge for controlling visible Chrome and Edge Agent Windows from DeepSeek Harness, with native browser tools, accessibility and VOM observations, screenshots, owned multi-session control, and a live Web UI overlay.
description.zh: BrowserSkill 的 DeepSeek Harness 浏览器自动化桥接插件，通过原生浏览器工具控制可见的 Chrome 和 Edge Agent Window，支持可访问性与 VOM 页面观察、截图、隔离的多会话控制和 Web UI 实时观察浮层。

description.en: Proactive associative memory for DSH: zero-prompt recall injected at a fixed boundary, three-layer auto-consolidation, skill crystallization, and Astra-style context management - handoff ledgers and a PLAN whiteboard that survive context-window switches, water-level sensing with an auto-detected model window. Local Markdown storage, model-agnostic, zero deps; lexical 0GB floor with optional semant
description.zh: 主动联想记忆 + Astra 式上下文管理：自动唤回（固定边界注入，前缀缓存友好）/自动沉淀/技能固化/交接账本与 PLAN 白板跨窗口续命/水位感知（窗口自动适配当前模型）。本地 Markdown 存储，模型无关，零依赖；词法 0GB 兜底，可选语义档。

description.en: Local image and MP4 video backgrounds for DSH Web and Desktop, plus Codex, Cursor, Doubao and WorkBuddy: a sidebar Background panel, saved named themes, a sound switch, restore-last-background, a background-only "slack" mode, and /bg, /bg-theme, /bg-clear commands.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 与 Desktop 设置本地图片与 MP4 视频背景（也支持 Codex、Cursor、豆包、WorkBuddy）：侧栏「背景」面板、可保存命名主题、声音开关、恢复上次背景、只留背景的摸鱼模式，以及 /bg、/bg-theme、/bg-clear 命令。

description.en: iLife: one DSH settings card for the iLife home-life suite — memo, calorie, chef, home, schedule and bill in a tab bar — covering every part of your home life.
description.zh: 爱生活-覆盖你居家生活的方方面面。

description.en: The memory that dreams — cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: recalls you and your projects across sessions, consolidates memories while idle (autoDream), freezes conflicting memories for your review, and keeps a replayable audit trail. Memory stays on your machine as SQLite with human-editable Markdown mirrors; four-way recall (keyword, vector, BM25, entity graph) and an interactive memory
description.zh: 会做梦的记忆 — DeepSeek Harness 跨会话记忆插件：跨会话记住你与项目，空闲时自动巩固记忆（autoDream），冲突记忆先冻结待你裁决，全程可回放审计。记忆落在本机：SQLite 存储配可人工编辑的 Markdown 镜像；附带四路召回（关键词、向量、BM25、实体图谱）与交互式记忆库面板，另有 10 个模型工具、MCP 服务端、外部 API 与 CLI。摘要与巩固走你已配置的宿主模型；把嵌入换成本地模型后，语义检索可完全离线运行。

description.en: Create editable Blender product scenes in DSH. Start from speaker, cup and lamp recipes or imported models; view saved results on the Lighttable, compare revisions, and adjust dimensions, materials, cameras and lights. Place static models on actual mesh surfaces in one saved operation. Render images or saved-shot videos and export an editable revision with its assets. Native geometry inspections,
description.zh: 在 DSH 中创建可编辑的 Blender 产品场景。从音箱、杯与灯具配方或导入模型开始，在光台查看保存结果、比较版本，调整尺寸、材质、相机与灯光。一次操作将静态模型放到实际网格表面并保存。渲染图片或分镜影片，也可将一个版本连同素材导出为可编辑副本。原生几何检查、不可变历史和审批闸门帮助保留已有作品。适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 并保留旧宿主入口，提供 19 个建模、评审与交付工具。

description.en: Adds an editable conversation canvas to DeepSeek Harness, where graph connections select context for canvas requests, with branching, merging, and local agent session imports.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中嵌入可编辑对话画布，通过连线选择画布请求的上下文，支持分支、合并与本地 Agent 会话导入。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory under the "memory palace" metaphor: dual-scope SQLite stores (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval with RRF fusion and recency/proof ranking boost, automatic capture from the session log (including the final turn), provenance audit chains, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a settings-page Memory Library panel with co
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆插件，以「记忆宫殿」隐喻重构 agent 长期记忆：双层 SQLite 分库（用户级 + 按 git origin 隔离的项目级）、FTS5 + 本地向量 RRF 融合与新鲜度/命中排序 boost、从会话日志自动摄取（含末轮）、来源审计链、巩固蒸馏与衰减遗忘，以及设置页「记忆库」面板（走廊拓扑、导览管家、翻新清单）。

description.en: Qwen Token Plan CN Responses provider for DeepSeek Harness via the OpenAI Responses API, with Qwen server-side tools, DSH local function tools, text/reasoning/tool-call multi-turn history, persisted image attachments, and a per-release official model catalog snapshot.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的千问 Token Plan 个人版 Responses API 提供方，保留 Qwen 服务端内置工具与 DSH 本地函数工具，多轮文本/推理/工具调用历史与图片附件均被支持，官方模型目录按 npm 版本冻结快照发布。

description.en: HuaweiCloud DevKit gives AI agents complete command of Huawei Cloud — build, deploy, operate, always governed, always secure.
description.zh: 让 AI 智能体掌握华为云全流程操作——构建、部署、运维全程受控，助您轻松安全上云。

description.en: Pre-boot health checks and repair for dsh plugin trees — ten static scan rules that follow the launcher runtime resolution, fault attribution after a failed boot, whitelisted reversible fixes verified in an isolated instance first, an upgrade preview naming the plugins a target release would skip, and a panel with plugin-row management plus a RAG knowledge base of past failures.
description.zh: dsh 插件树的启动前体检与修复——十条跟随启动器运行时解析的静态规则、启动失败后的故障归因、先在隔离实例复验再落地的白名单可逆修复、点名目标版本会跳过哪些插件的升级预演，以及带插件行管理面板与历次故障 RAG 知识库的设置界面。

description.en: Kanban task board for DeepSeek Harness sessions: the main agent dispatches tasks to one-shot worker/verifier subagents, with dependency scheduling, file-level exclusion locks, arbitration hold/freeze, milestone progress reporting, and per-task token usage stats.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话任务看板：主窗口把任务派发给一次性 Worker/Verifier 子代理执行与验收，支持依赖调度、文件级排他锁、裁决挂起冻结、里程碑进展上报与任务级 Token 消耗统计。

description.en: ChatGPT account sign-in for DeepSeek Harness through a Codex browser OAuth flow with no API key and no workspace selection: subscribes the login to pi-ai's Codex provider, lets you set the global default Codex model and reasoning effort for new sessions, refreshes the model list from the signed-in account's own catalog endpoint, and shows the five-hour and weekly usage windows in the composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatGPT 账号登录：走 Codex 浏览器 OAuth，无需 API Key、无需选择工作空间；把登录结果接到 pi-ai 的 Codex provider，可设置新会话默认的 Codex 模型与思考强度，并按账号自己的目录接口刷新模型列表，在输入区展示 5 小时与每周用量窗口。

description.en: Reads the session files thirty-three other coding agents on this machine already wrote — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot Chat, opencode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Kimi, Cline, Zed and more — including sessions from before it was installed: six tools (deja_recall, deja_session, deja_blame, deja_fix, deja_how, deja_remember), a /deja command, and optional automatic recall added to the runtime co
description.zh: 读取本机上其他三十三个编程智能体已经写下的会话文件——Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code Copilot Chat、opencode、OpenClaw、Hermes、Kimi、Cline、Zed 等，包括安装之前的历史：提供 deja_recall、deja_session、deja_blame、deja_fix、deja_how、deja_remember 六个工具与 /deja 命令，并可选地把召回结果加入运行时上下文。本地 BM25 索引，不用大模型，不用向量嵌入，不联网（dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja）。

description.en: Four read-only tools over a WeKnora knowledge base: list knowledge bases, hybrid passage search, reassemble one document's chunks in order, and WeKnora's own cited RAG or ReAct-agent answer with a resumable session id.
description.zh: 把 WeKnora 知识库接入 dsh 的四个只读工具：列出知识库、混合检索原文片段、按顺序还原单篇文档，以及直接取用 WeKnora 自己带引用的 RAG 或 ReAct agent 回答（含可续聊的 session id）。

description.en: fnOS 飞牛 NAS integration for DeepSeek Harness, working through the fnOS browser SDK when the Web UI runs inside an fnOS app frame: follows the NAS theme while DSH is set to system preference, lists and revokes authorized NAS directory grants in Settings, opens files and links in the matching fnOS app, and syncs the DSH page title to the fnOS app window. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile w
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接进飞牛 fnOS：DSH 界面跑在 fnOS 应用框架里时通过 fnOS 浏览器 SDK 工作——DSH 设为跟随系统时读取并跟随 NAS 主题，在设置里列出和取消已授权的 NAS 目录，把文件与链接交给对应的 fnOS 应用打开，并把 DSH 页面标题同步到 fnOS 应用窗口。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`。

description.en: MCP server manager (stdio / streamable-http): per-working-directory project and global config tiers; project-level MCP collapsed into 4 atomic tools through a middleware layer by default (`middleware: all` folds in global servers too, hot-switchable in the settings page); workspace isolation prevents cross-project interference; configs keep `${ENV}` references only, with no plaintext secrets on di
description.zh: MCP 服务器管理器（stdio / streamable-http）：按工作目录分项目级/全局两级配置；项目级 MCP 默认经中间层收敛为 4 个原子工具（`middleware: all` 连同全局服务器一并收敛，设置页热切换）；工作空间隔离防串台；配置只存 `${ENV}` 引用、不落盘明文密钥；提供运行时注册接口供其他插件注入 MCP。

description.en: Remote development launcher for DeepSeek Harness: provisions dsh on a remote host via SSH (or a local WSL distro) and connects from the local client, with LLM credentials proxied through a reverse tunnel so they never leave the local machine. Ships as both a standalone CLI and a dsh plugin with a session panel, /remote-explorer slash command and remote_* agent tools.
description.zh: 远程开发启动器：通过 SSH（或本机 WSL 发行版）在远端引导安装 dsh，从本地客户端连接，LLM 凭据经反向隧道代理、不离开本机。同时提供独立 CLI 与 dsh 插件双形态，插件含远程会话面板、/remote-explorer 命令及 remote_* agent 工具。

description.en: Task-event notification center: 6 event kinds (ask / approval / completion / subagent completion / error / turn end), dual channels (browser Notification + host system toast) plus Bark/Webhook push channels (ntfy, Gotify, self-hosted gateways); quiet hours with urgent exceptions, approval-timeout re-reminders, completion-storm aggregation, and notification text redaction.
description.zh: 任务事件通知中心：6 类事件（提问 / 审批 / 完成 / 子代理完成 / 错误 / 轮次完成），双通道（浏览器通知 + 宿主系统 toast）外加 Bark/Webhook 推送频道（ntfy、Gotify、自建网关）；支持免打扰时段与紧急例外、审批超时二次提醒、完成风暴聚合、通知文本脱敏。

description.en: All-in-one local memory: JSONL files per scope (session, project, global, or a custom name) with per-scope dedup, five model tools (memory_save, memory_search, memory_list, memory_get, memory_forget), automatic recall and hard rules injected into the agent pre-step, and a settings panel. Retrieval combines lexical IDF with a local embedding backend, which the panel can install and manage itself.
description.zh: 一体化本地记忆：按作用域（会话、项目、全局或自定义名）各一个 JSONL 文件、作用域内按内容去重，五个模型工具（memory_save / memory_search / memory_list / memory_get / memory_forget），自动召回与硬性规则注入 agent 的 pre-step，并带一个设置面板。检索是词法 IDF 与本地向量后端的组合，向量后端可由面板一键安装并托管。

description.en: Business knowledge-network context for DeepSeek Harness: bind a session to an OpenBKN knowledge network, query its objects and metrics through managed MCP tools, and open trace-backed provenance (execution facts and a business graph) for each answer. Ships with the OpenBKN Runtime; the provenance views need an OpenBKN enterprise license.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供业务知识网络上下文：将会话绑定到 OpenBKN 知识网络，通过受管 MCP 工具查询对象与指标，并为每轮回答打开可溯源的执行事实与业务上下文图。随 OpenBKN Runtime 发布；溯源视图需企业版 License。

description.en: Claude-style drag-and-drop/paperclip file upload with content sniffing, document-to-Markdown via Microsoft MarkItDown (built-in JS fallback), text inlining, and a read_document tool for agents.
description.zh: Claude 风格拖拽/回形针文件上传：内容嗅探、文档转 Markdown（微软 MarkItDown，内置 JS 兜底）、文本直插输入框、read_document 工具。

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a microphone button in the composer turns speech into a draft transcript, with a choice of speech-recognition backends, optional polish through dsh own LLM routes, and a native settings page.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的语音输入插件：输入框的麦克风按钮把语音转成草稿文本，支持多种语音识别后端，可选经 dsh 自有 LLM 路由润色，并带原生设置页。

description.en: Early-stage plugin connecting DeepSeek Harness to a separately deployed, self-hosted OwnDsh server for team identity, model access control, quotas, and usage auditing.
description.zh: 早期开发中的团队管理插件，将 DeepSeek Harness 接入独立部署的自托管 OwnDsh 服务端，提供团队身份、模型授权、配额与用量审计。

description.en: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files g
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 host 级主动唤醒：模型用 proactive_set 给自己设定闹钟（单次 / 循环间隔 / cron，支持 jitter 随机抖动），到点自动唤醒冷会话执行心跳、定时提醒与任务跟进；安静时段与每日投递预算约束模型自主跟进，静默唤醒以 proactive_reclaim 收尾并把唤醒上下文折叠为墓碑；声明式闹钟文件把 JSON 时间表幂等同步成 host 闹钟，min_idle_seconds 静默门让唤醒等会话空闲；自带 Web 管理面板（设置页节 + 会话页签，SSE 实时刷新）管理闹钟与唤醒历史——适合驱动 AI 陪伴、角色扮演（酒馆式人设）与 living agent 的心跳、日常安排和世界演算。

description.en: Shared Markdown memory for DSH and other coding agents, with automatic capture, pre-step context injection, searchable recall, and memory-to-skill self-evolution through a review panel.
description.zh: 供 DSH 与其他编程 Agent 共享的 Markdown 记忆，支持自动捕获、步骤前上下文注入、搜索召回，以及通过审阅面板实现 memory-to-skill 自进化。

description.en: Replaces the terminal tool on Windows with Git Bash.
description.zh: 可将 Windows 环境下的终端工具替换为 Git Bash

description.en: Read official DSH docs in the Plugins page; Creator mode searches docs and checks plugin npm metadata with native tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页阅读官方文档；创造模式用原生工具检索文档、查询插件 npm 元数据。

description.en: File-backed post office between DeepSeek Harness sessions: every letter is sealed with an HMAC and a body digest, recipients are resolved through a roster interface, and delivery is offline-first, so an undeliverable letter waits in the mailbox instead of being lost.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话之间的文件信箱：每封信都用 HMAC 与正文摘要封好，收件人通过名单接口解析，默认离线投递——投不出去的信留在信箱里等人来收，不会丢。

description.en: Third-party adapter that registers the upstream REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server into DeepSeek Harness as mcp__rea__* tools. 2.x provisions its own runtime (Node, the REA CLI, a JDK, Ghidra) under <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle and launches REA through a shim, so a machine with nothing pre-installed works after one setup run; 1.x (branch v1, npm 1.0.6) is configuration-only and expects RE
description.zh: 第三方适配插件：把上游 REA（逆向一切，github.com/morluto/rea）的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 mcp__rea__* 工具。2.x 自带供给：把 Node、REA CLI、JDK、Ghidra 装到 <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle 下，再经 shim 启动 REA —— 干净机器跑一次 setup 即可用；1.x（v1 分支 / npm 1.0.6）是纯配置适配器，需要你自己装好 REA 与 Ghidra。逆向分析能力由 REA 提供，覆盖原生二进制（Hopper/Ghidra/IDA）、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集、网站、Android APK 与 adb 设备、固件与进程捕获。

description.en: Standalone mobile surface for dsh: scan-to-pair device trust, realtime SSE sync, three-channel completion notifications (in-app / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram), offline outbox, approval & question panels, per-provider usage meters, PWA; a native narrow-screen phone UI.
description.zh: dsh 的独立手机端界面：扫码配对设备信任、实时 SSE 同步、三通道完成通知（应用内 / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram）、离线发件箱、审批与提问面板、多提供方用量卡、PWA；从零为窄屏设计的原生手机 UI。

description.en: Multi-provider usage stats framework (v2 adapter contract): persistent capsule plus detail panel; DeepSeek official (interval-bookkeeping daily usage derivation with a peak/valley countdown badge, working even without an official usage endpoint) and OpenCode Go built in; any other data source joins by dropping in a single mjs adapter file, hot-swappable from the settings page, with API keys kept o
description.zh: 多 provider 用量统计框架（v2 适配器契约）：常驻胶囊 + 详情面板；内置 DeepSeek 官方（区间记账法推算每日用量 + 峰谷倒计时徽标，官方无用量接口也能算）与 OpenCode Go；其他数据源只需放入一个 mjs 适配器文件即可接入，设置页热插拔，密钥只留在宿主端。

description.en: Lark/Feishu bot channel for DeepSeek Harness: each chat drives its own agent, and tool approvals, model questions, and plan reviews return as cards answered by a button or a reply. Switch workspace and model from the chat (`/cd`, `/model`, `/new`), and run several bots that keep separate sessions and can hand turns to each other in one group.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 机器人渠道：每个会话驱动独立 agent，工具审批、模型提问与计划审阅都以卡片回到聊天，点按钮或直接回复即可作答；聊天里用 `/cd`、`/model`、`/new` 切工作区、换模型、重开会话，多个机器人各自独立并可在同群交接回合。

description.en: FormatForge: forge 30+ file formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, EML, EPUB, TOML, archives) into AI-readable text via a drag-and-drop inbox, ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result tools and a CLI; scanned PDFs fall back to local OCR or an enhance hint for the session model.
description.zh: FormatForge：把 30+ 种文件格式（PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、EML、EPUB、TOML、压缩包）锻造成 AI 可读文本——网页拖拽入箱自动转换，提供 ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result 工具与 CLI；扫描件回退本地 OCR 或交给会话模型增强。

description.en: Interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness: tables, Mermaid and chart rendering, side conversations, and the same Cordis plugin model as dsh Web.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 交互式终端界面：表格、Mermaid 与图表渲染、旁支会话，以及与 dsh Web 相同的 Cordis 插件模型。

description.en: Profile-wide DSH governance and routing with a Web Control Center for responsibility and evidence inspection, plus compaction, scoped semantic memory, safety continuity, and verified delivery; compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1.
description.zh: 面向整个 DSH profile 的治理与路由 bundle，提供用于职责与证据检查的 Web Control Center，以及压缩、本地作用域语义记忆、安全连续性与真实验收；兼容 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。

description.en: Patent-writing gatekeeper for dsh - screens the idea against Chinese prior art first, then runs five-party alignment interviews, eight-chapter disclosure drafting, figures and simulation runs, seven-dimension review and docx/PDF export. Skills work out of the box; the search, export and experiment tools come from a bundled Python MCP service that ships disabled - one line in ~/.dsh/patent-services
description.zh: dsh 专利撰写把关人：动笔前先检索中国专利给出三档结论，再走五方对齐访谈、八章交底书、附图与仿真实验、七维审查与 docx/PDF 导出全流程。技能开箱即用；检索、导出与实验工具来自内置的 Python MCP 服务，默认关闭——在 ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml 里开一行即启用，uvx 会从 PyPI 自动拉取。

description.en: DeepSeek wallet balance at the sidebar foot: a credit-card icon with the amount tinted by remaining balance (green over ¥2, amber ¥0–2, red below), refreshed on mount, per turn-end, and on click; a signed delta floats up and fades on each balance change.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部的 DeepSeek 钱包余额：信用卡图标配余额数字，按剩余额度着色（≥ ¥2 绿色、¥0–2 黄色、≤ ¥0 红色），挂载时、每轮对话结束和点击时刷新；余额变动时带符号差额上飘淡出。

description.en: Input experience enhancement: voice input, AI polish, anti-overwrite, prompt optimization with diff preview, and auto locale switching following DSH UI language.
description.zh: 输入体验增强插件，目前已实现语音输入、AI提示词润色（反覆盖保护、带差异预览的提示词优化）、跟随 DSH 界面语言自动切换中英文界面。

description.en: Terminal-native TUI frontend for DeepSeek Harness that presents sessions, models, plugins, jobs, subagents, todos, and provider configuration through Harness capabilities while preserving real terminal scrollback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端原生 TUI 前端，通过 Harness 能力提供会话、模型、插件、任务、子代理、待办事项和 Provider 配置，并保留真实的终端滚动历史。

description.en: DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription: attach images in the GUI and each one is transcribed via the official deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp by default (a pure-text V4-Pro brain can see images), with any OpenAI-compatible VLM or local Ollama as alternatives.
description.zh: DeepSeek 大脑 + 自动识图：GUI 附加的每张图片自动经官方 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 原生识图转译，再交给纯文本的 DeepSeek 作答（纯文本 V4-Pro 也能看图）；支持任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM 与本地 Ollama 作为备选。

description.en: Tencent CloudBase backend for DeepSeek Harness — scaffold and deploy full-stack apps from chat, render query results as table cards with paging, sorting and CSV export, preview a deployment on its domain, and call the CloudBase MCP toolset (`mcp__cloudbase__*`) with device-code login.
description.zh: 把腾讯云 CloudBase 后端接入 DeepSeek Harness——在对话里搭好并部署全栈应用，查询结果渲染为表格卡片（分页、排序、导出 CSV），部署后可预览真实域名，并提供 CloudBase MCP 工具集（`mcp__cloudbase__*`），登录走 device-code 流程。

description.en: Daily sending quotas and quiet hours for agent mailboxes: letters are counted in named buckets that each carry a per-day limit, the day boundary is configurable, and a quiet window tells the core to hold online letters rather than deliver them.
description.zh: 智能体信箱的每日配额与免打扰时段：信件按命名桶计数、每桶有每日上限，日界可配置，并给出一个免打扰窗口，让核心把在线件留着而不投递。

description.en: Access the dsh web UI over LAN: HTTP/HTTPS/WS forwarding plus TLS (self-signed or custom certificates); adaptive Brotli/gzip compression for HTTP and permessage-deflate for WebSocket; half-open WebSocket probing keeps mobile clients from going stale after backgrounding; launch-token auto-injection lets LAN devices connect without copying the token; DNS-rebinding protection + loopback-only upstream
description.zh: 局域网访问 dsh web UI：HTTP/HTTPS/WS 转发 + TLS（自签名/自定义证书）；HTTP 自适应 Brotli/gzip 与 WebSocket permessage-deflate 双压缩；WS 半开探活，移动端切后台不僵死；启动令牌自动注入，LAN 设备免手工拿 token；DNS 重绑定防护 + 回环-only 上游白名单。

description.en: SQLX database tools: list saved datasources, show or test a connection, execute SQL and open a local result page, with the sqlx CLI installed on first use.
description.zh: OtterMind SQLX 数据库工具：列出已保存的数据源、查看或测试连接、执行 SQL、打开本地结果页，缺少 sqlx CLI 时首次调用自动安装。

description.en: Skill-driven harness/loop engineering workflow agent plugin.
description.zh: 技能驱动的 harness/loop 工程化工作流插件。

description.en: Shared toolkit for authoring DeepSeek Harness plugins, published as @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit: a pluggable provider registry seam, fail-closed approval and session-event gates, shared sanitize/pricing/judge modules and a new-plugin skeleton.
description.zh: 编写 DeepSeek Harness 插件的共享工具包，发布为 @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit：可插拔的 Provider 注册表接缝、失败即拒绝的审批与会话事件门、共享的脱敏/计价/裁决模块，以及新插件骨架。

description.en: Verifies letters signed by other agents: a canonical field order, digest and HMAC checks, and fail-closed handling of missing or unregistered fields. Off by default; when enabled, a letter that fails any check is refused rather than delivered.
description.zh: 校验其他 agent 写来的信：规范字段顺序、摘要与 HMAC 校验。默认关闭；开启后，缺字段或未登记字段不放行，任何一项不过就拒收。

description.en: Sticky-notes board for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry opens a Markdown note panel with auto-save, colors, image paste and task-list rendering.
description.zh: dsh 便签插件：侧栏入口打开 Markdown 便签面板，支持自动保存、颜色标签、粘贴图片与任务清单。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: agents save, search and update user preferences, facts and project decisions; important entries are injected into later sessions, and a Settings section lists, edits, archives or deletes them.
description.zh: dsh 跨会话记忆：agent 保存、检索并更新用户偏好、事实与项目决策，重要条目自动注入后续会话，设置面板可浏览、编辑、归档与删除。

description.en: Adds a Worktree view to DSH Web UI that groups Sessions by Git worktree while keeping DSH as the source of truth.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 增加按 Git Worktree 组织 Session 的视角，同时继续由 DSH 管理原始 Project 和 Session 数据。

description.en: Forge quality gates for DeepSeek Harness: task gates, read-before-edit, bash hazard interception and quality scoring, enforced by the local forge CLI through DSH's typed interception points. Requires the forge CLI on PATH; without it the plugin fails open and says so with a best-effort notice at session start, and task gates also need forge init in the project.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Forge 质量门禁：任务门禁、改前必读、危险命令拦截与质量评分，经 DSH 类型化拦截点由本地 forge CLI 执行。需本机安装 forge CLI，缺失时插件 fail-open 并在会话开始时尽力提示；任务门禁还要求项目已执行 forge init。

description.en: Git status badges for DSH: sidebar workspace-row badges and an input-row chip showing the current conversation's workspace git state, with event-driven freshness over SSE.
description.zh: DSH 的 Git 状态徽章：侧边栏工作区行徽章与输入行徽章，显示当前会话工作区的 git 状态，通过 SSE 事件驱动保持实时。

description.en: Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: scan-to-connect PersonalAgent binding, streaming cards, git-worktree project workspaces, parallel per-scope tasks, multi-role agents, cross-session notify, in-chat model/key management, and a safety-net guardian that still answers in Feishu after dsh crashes.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进飞书的桥接插件：扫码绑定 PersonalAgent、流式卡片、git worktree 项目工作区、scope 并行任务、多角色 Agent、跨会话通知、对话内模型/密钥管理，以及 dsh 崩溃后仍在飞书应答的安全网守护。

description.en: Indexes session transcripts into the Akasha session layer as turns end, records successful compactions, and adds a per-turn rhythm line to the runtime context. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absolute path (or set the AKAS
description.zh: 回合结束时把会话档案增量索引进阿卡夏会话层，记录压缩事件，并在运行时上下文里显示每回合节奏条。（配套：Hindsight 仓库记忆 / OpenViking 用户记忆 / 宿主会话检索；见仓库 README） 安装：clone 仓库并复制 core/，把 cordis.patch.yml 里的 <AKASHA_DIR> 换成实际路径（或设 AKASHA_DIR 环境变量）；占位符未替换时插件会明确报错。

description.en: Configurable deterministic session titles for DeepSeek Harness from semantic prompt fields and templates.
description.zh: 基于语义 prompt 字段与自定义模板的 DeepSeek Harness 确定性会话标题生成插件。

description.en: Runs commands as background jobs that keep executing when DSH exits, with an optional sandbox to constrain file effects, plus a live web panel and offline CLI/GUI management. Windows only for now.
description.zh: 将命令提交为独立于 DSH 进程的后台任务（可选沙箱），关闭 DSH 也不影响运行，并提供实时网页面板与离线 CLI/GUI 管理。当前仅支持Windows系统。

description.en: Schedules Akasha sleep distillation on idle or timer, and injects a wake note for new sessions plus a per-turn memory pulse; the optional idle-resume behaviour is off by default. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absolute pa
description.zh: 空闲或定时触发阿卡夏睡眠蒸馏，并为新会话注入唤醒条、每回合注入库脉搏；可选的空闲续行默认关闭。（配套：Hindsight 仓库记忆 / OpenViking 用户记忆 / 宿主会话检索；见仓库 README） 安装：clone 仓库并复制 core/，把 cordis.patch.yml 里的 <AKASHA_DIR> 换成实际路径（或设 AKASHA_DIR 环境变量）；占位符未替换时插件会明确报错。

description.en: Component checklist for the shared Semi Design package used by tnnevol DSH plugins, opened from a `Semi UI` button in a conversation header: 35 components plus a multi-account case page, organised into seven sidebar groups from inputs, forms, selectors and trees to tables, cards, overlays and feedback, each rendered live with a one-line description and a page outline, with light, dark and follow-s
description.zh: tnnevol 系列 DSH 插件共用的 Semi Design 组件检查页，从会话头部的 `Semi UI` 按钮进入：35 个组件加一个多账号案例页，按七个侧边分组组织，涵盖输入、表单、选择器、树、表格、卡片、浮层与反馈，逐个实渲并配一句话说明与页内目录，可切换浅色、深色与跟随系统预览。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-semi-ui-showcase`。

description.en: MCP server installer and verifier for DeepSeek Harness: interactive init writes real patch entries into a profile, list and validate inspect them, and a CI-enforced verifier connects to every curated server.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器安装与验证工具：交互式 init 会把真实 patch 条目写进 profile，list 与 validate 检查配置，CI 强制的验证器逐个连接精选服务器。

description.en: Isolated-environment browser verification skill for DSH plugin development: a throwaway DSH_HOME, its own `verify_<random>` profile, its own port and its own browser instance in one command, cleaned up on exit, so the profile you are actually using is never touched; ships a zero-dependency raw-CDP driver (snapshot / click / screenshot / eval) and an optional isolation audit.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发的隔离环境浏览器验证 skill：一条命令拉起临时 DSH_HOME、独立 `verify_<随机>` profile、独立端口与独立浏览器实例，退出自动清理，不污染正在使用的 profile；自带零依赖 raw-CDP 浏览器驱动（快照 / 点击 / 截图 / 求值）与可选隔离审计。

description.en: Token usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: a bar above the composer opens billing token totals, trend charts, per-model and per-project breakdowns and a custom date range, read from local session logs of DSH, Codex, Claude Code, Trae and WorkBuddy. With a self-hosted portal URL and an app key it also reports usage events to that portal; with neither configured it collects nothing. It exposes token_us
description.zh: DSH 的 token 用量面板：输入框上方一条用量条，点开是计费总量、趋势图、按模型/项目/来源的分组明细与自定义日期范围，数据来自本机 DSH / Codex / Claude Code / Trae / WorkBuddy 的会话日志；填了自建服务端地址与 appKey 后，用量事件会实时上报到那个服务端，两者都没配时一个字节都不采集；另提供 token_usage 工具与 ctx.tokenReport 服务。不采集对话内容。

description.en: Pushes DSH session events to phone IM and lets you reply straight under that message, injecting the text back into the right session. Covers nine event kinds: task completion, execution error, execution blocked, manual abort, token limit reached, abnormal interruption, waiting for your answer, permission request, and waiting for plan confirmation. Channels are QQ single-chat bots and Feishu custom
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话事件推到手机 IM，并允许在那条消息下直接回复回注到正确会话。覆盖九类事件：任务完成、执行错误、执行被阻塞、手动中止、Token 达到上限、异常中断、等待我回答、权限请求、等待计划确认；通道支持 QQ 单聊机器人与飞书自建应用，两者均走 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 IP、域名或内网穿透。可同时配置多台机器人，各自订阅自己关心的会话。审批与提问以可点按钮下发，回复按「按钮 → 引用回复 → 显式短 id 前缀」三层路由归位，兜底发给最近一条需人介入的通知并回显投递目标。

description.en: Work reports for DeepSeek Harness: gathers Git commits and local agent conversations (DeepSeek/Claude/Codex) and renders daily, weekly or monthly reports from your own templates; the agent tool is injected on demand.
description.zh: dsh 工作报告：汇总 Git 提交与本地 agent 对话（DeepSeek/Claude/Codex），按自定义模板生成日报/周报/月报，agent 工具按需注入。

description.en: Write guard for the Akasha Book store: blocks tool calls that write into the memory data directory, and injects the store usage contract and self-layer sections into the system prompt. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absol
description.zh: 阿卡夏之书门控：拦截写入记忆数据目录的工具调用，并把库用法约定与自我层注入系统提示。（配套：Hindsight 仓库记忆 / OpenViking 用户记忆 / 宿主会话检索；见仓库 README） 安装：clone 仓库并复制 core/，把 cordis.patch.yml 里的 <AKASHA_DIR> 换成实际路径（或设 AKASHA_DIR 环境变量）；占位符未替换时插件会明确报错。

description.en: Terminal coding agent for DeepSeek Harness with a full-screen alternate-screen UI, turn-aware session navigation, and a gated /ship workflow that takes one-line requirements through specification, TDD, and rerun acceptance checks.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的终端编码 Agent，提供全屏备用屏幕 UI、轮次感知的会话导航，以及将一句话需求经过规格、TDD 和验收复跑的分阶段 /ship 流程。

description.en: Not another memory plugin: ODR is an evolving-worlds self-improvement loop (Dream-RSI) — attempts are recorded into a Discovery Tree, and between runs thousands of strategy variants are replayed against that recorded world; a strategy, recipe or lesson is promoted only after surviving counterfactual replay, never on the model's word alone, and Sentinel gates tool calls before the budget burns; the
description.zh: 不是又一个记忆插件：ODR 是“演化世界”式（Dream-RSI）自我改进回路——每次尝试都记入发现树（Discovery Tree），任务间歇将数千个策略变体在这棵记录下来的世界上回放；策略、配方或经验只有通过反事实回放的考验才会晋升，绝不因模型自己说好就获得信任，Sentinel 还会在预算耗尽前拦截工具调用；LLM 保持冻结，可从 npm 安装 dsh-open-dream-rsi。

description.en: Multi-source web search and fetch failover for DeepSeek Harness sessions: takes over the session searchProvider and fetchProvider seams and tries configured sources in a chosen order — TinyFish, Tavily and the official search as a fallback that always participates and can be repositioned but not removed. Multiple API keys per platform are spread round-robin, usage snapshots drive pre-flight exclus
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供多来源网页搜索与抓取故障转移：接管会话的 searchProvider 与 fetchProvider 接缝，按可配置顺序尝试已配置来源——TinyFish、Tavily 与官方搜索，官方固定参与兜底、位置可调但不可移除。每平台可配多个 key 轮转分摊，基于用量快照做请求前账号排除，单请求超时与同平台重试控制转移粒度。网页抓取本地 HTTP 优先，失败后依次兜底 TinyFish Fetch 服务端渲染与 Tavily Extract，本机网络受限时代理或 DNS 拦不住页面抓取。插件页按平台展示各账号用量与套餐额度。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-failover-search`。

description.en: Records host events — turn ends, tool results, agent errors, idle transitions and assistant output — as append-only JSONL for Akasha metrics, recall checks and output audit. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absolute path (o
description.zh: 把宿主事件（回合结束、工具结果、agent 错误、空闲切换、assistant 输出）落成 append-only JSONL，供指标、召回检查与输出审计使用。（配套：Hindsight 仓库记忆 / OpenViking 用户记忆 / 宿主会话检索；见仓库 README） 安装：clone 仓库并复制 core/，把 cordis.patch.yml 里的 <AKASHA_DIR> 换成实际路径（或设 AKASHA_DIR 环境变量）；占位符未替换时插件会明确报错。

description.en: Sidebar panel for the announcement file and the ticket status table. It lists the announcements together with how many sessions have seen each one, shows the delivery status, and lets the user post, edit and delete entries. Requires the third-party dsh-better-sidebar plugin.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板：把公告和投递状态表放进 DSH 界面 —— 列出公告以及每条有几个会话见过，并让用户发布、编辑、删除条目。需要第三方插件 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: DSH web-GUI pet runtime that renders any Codex spritesheet-atlas pet (v1/v2) as a draggable overlay: drag/wave/jump, v2 mouse-tracking eyes that follow the active mouse, live agent-status poses, progress bubbles, and an in-GUI atlas importer; ships one original CC BY-NC demo pet (nastya), and user pets live in ~/.dsh/pets.
description.zh: DSH 网页 GUI 实时桌宠：可把任何 Codex 桌宠图集（webp/png/gif，v1/v2 自动识别）转换为 DSH 中可拖拽的悬浮桌宠。支持拖拽/挥手/跳跃，v2 桌宠的眼睛实时追踪活动鼠标，随 agent 状态切换姿势；进度气泡反映工作状态；「设置 → 桌宠」图形界面可导入、切换与调整桌宠；内置一只原创示例桌宠（娜斯佳），用户桌宠存放在 ~/.dsh/pets。

description.en: Usage and cost view for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates real token usage from existing session logs, locks each cost at the price of its event time, and shows month and today spend against a budget from a sidebar card or an input-bar pill.
description.zh: dsh 用量与费用视图：从既有会话日志聚合真实 token 用量，按事件发生时刻的价格写时锁定费用；侧栏卡片或输入框胶囊展示本月/今日花费与预算进度，设置页另有概览、趋势、明细三页。

description.en: AX-first macOS computer use for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility snapshots with stable refs, background input, Unicode typing, menus and apps, set-of-mark screenshots, on-device OCR and verified actions — 11 tools bridged to the macos-cu CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS computer use：基于无障碍树的稳定 ref 定位、后台输入、Unicode 输入、菜单与应用、set-of-mark 截图、本地 OCR 与动作校验——11 个工具桥接 macos-cu CLI。

description.en: Registers Ark Agent Plan, Coding Plan and postpaid model routes in the native DSH model picker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生模型选择器中注册方舟 Agent Plan、Coding Plan 与后付费模型路由。

description.en: Cross-session and cross-project long-term memory: a non-blocking silent sedimentation dispatch on turn/end writes into a local SQLite store (FTS5 trigram full-text index with insert/update/delete sync triggers) that later turns recall from; entries are scoped per project alongside a global tree, and the plugin ships its own embedded web dashboard (it starts the HTTP server itself, no separate proc
description.zh: 跨会话、跨工程的长期记忆：turn/end 时非阻塞派发无感静默沉淀，写入本机 SQLite（FTS5 trigram 全文索引，含增删改同步触发器）供后续回合召回；记忆按项目作用域与全局树分层存储，并自带内嵌 Web 看板（插件自身起 HTTP 服务，非独立进程）用于浏览、图谱与受控删除。

description.en: Native iOS and Android apps for remote control of DeepSeek Harness, with end-to-end encryption, workspace browsing, and real-time session updates.
description.zh: 提供 DeepSeek Harness 远程控制功能的原生 iOS/Android 应用，支持端到端加密、工作区浏览和会话实时更新等。

description.en: Bridges the agent to a persistent OKF memory vault over MCP stdio: a Python server (SQLite FTS5 + Markdown) with 10 tools for searching and storing decisions, facts, learnings, conventions, profiles and sources.
description.zh: 经 MCP stdio 把 Agent 接入持久化 OKF 记忆库：Python 服务端（SQLite FTS5 + Markdown），10 个工具用于检索与写入决策、事实和偏好。

description.en: Load Claude Code assets into DSH at runtime — skills, slash commands, rules, permission rules (deny/ask/allow), subagents and hooks from .claude/ plus Claude Code plugins (plugin.json / marketplace / skills / agents / MCP), via a memory-IR parse layer that keeps .claude as the source of truth with no writes back. Six installable packages: loader, skills, permissions, agents, hooks, mcp.
description.zh: 运行时把 Claude Code 全家桶原样加载进 DSH：.claude/ 的技能、斜杠命令、规则、权限（deny/ask/allow）、子代理与 hooks，以及 Claude Code 插件（plugin.json / marketplace / 技能 / 代理 / MCP）——内存 IR 解析层，.claude 始终是唯一事实来源，零回写。六个可安装包：loader、skills、permissions、agents、hooks、mcp。

description.en: DSH side of the dsh-ecolink memory ecosystem: bridges chat.deepseek.com and DeepSeek Harness through a browser extension that harvests DSM-format memory tags and injects recalled memories into web chats, a zero-dependency local service that writes a shared memory pool, and this adapter, which injects memories pre-step and offers /ecolink-push write-back; compression is transactional (staging pool
description.zh: dsh-ecolink 记忆生态的 dsh 侧组件：浏览器扩展收割 DSM 格式记忆标签并向网页对话注入回忆、零依赖本地服务写入共享记忆池、本 adapter 负责 pre-step 注入与 /ecolink-push 写回，共同打通 chat.deepseek.com 与 DSH；压缩为事务化双池（暂存提交/回滚）。

description.en: Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle with DeepSeek fallback, keyless search) plus a Tavily MCP bridge: keyless search and extract tools, crawl and map with an API key.
description.zh: Tavily 网页搜索：设置页开关，关闭时回落到 DeepSeek 内置搜索；免密钥可用搜索与内容提取，配置 API Key 后解锁爬取与站点地图等 MCP 工具。

description.en: Desk-to-desk tickets between sessions on one machine. A session says which desk it belongs to by putting a number prefix in its title; a ticket names one desk and is taken by the first session of that desk to start working, so the desk is the address and a ticket is not delivered to a session that is just passing by.
description.zh: 同一台电脑上会话之间的「单子」：会话用标题里的编号前缀表明自己属于哪张桌；单子投给某张桌，由那张桌最先开始干活的那个会话取走 —— 桌是地址，路过的会话不会收到它。

description.en: Firecrawl MCP bridge: hosted Firecrawl MCP server with keyless search, scrape and parse; an API key unlocks the full tool surface including crawl and map.
description.zh: 接入 Firecrawl 托管 MCP 服务：免密钥即可使用搜索、抓取与解析（有每日额度），配置 API Key 后解锁完整工具集，含爬取与站点地图。

description.en: Context7 MCP bridge: gives the model up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples through the Context7 MCP server, keyless by default.
description.zh: 接入 Context7 托管 MCP 服务，为 agent 提供随版本更新的库文档查询；默认免密钥可用。

description.en: Per-step model router: named presets with ordered image/keyword-group rules route each agent step across every mounted provider and model, adding collaboration flows for image transcription, an image guard, a multi-plan quota panel, and per-step decision observability.
description.zh: 逐步模型路由器：以命名预设与带图/关键词组有序规则为每一步在全部已挂载模型间选路，附图像转述协作流、图像护栏、多 plan 配额面板与逐步决策可观测。

description.en: Registers Baidu, Doubao, Tavily, and Exa backends into ctx.web so official web_search can use them, and routes web_fetch through Tavily Extract or Exa Contents when that backend is active.
description.zh: 向 ctx.web 注册百度、豆包、Tavily、Exa 后端供官方 web_search 使用，并在 Tavily 或 Exa 生效时将 web_fetch 转到对应提取接口。

description.en: Registers the Akasha Book memory server over stdio and exposes its 22 akasha_* tools to DeepSeek Harness, covering lookup, briefs, revision chains, audits and session recall. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absolute path (
description.zh: 把阿卡夏之书外置记忆层以 stdio 注册进 DSH，暴露 22 个 akasha_* 工具：检索、主题简报、修订链、审计与会话回看。（配套：Hindsight 仓库记忆 / OpenViking 用户记忆 / 宿主会话检索；见仓库 README） 安装：clone 仓库并复制 core/，把 cordis.patch.yml 里的 <AKASHA_DIR> 换成实际路径（或设 AKASHA_DIR 环境变量）；占位符未替换时插件会明确报错。

description.en: Makes 1080x1920 vertical promo videos from a storyboard JSON with 7 tools (doctor, setup, catalog, guide, validate, render, verify), rendered locally with Remotion.
description.zh: 从分镜 JSON 生成 1080×1920 竖版宣传片，含 7 个工具（doctor、setup、catalog、guide、validate、render、verify），用 Remotion 本地渲染。

description.en: An announcement file shared by several agent sessions on one machine. It is a plain text file the agents only append to; before each step a session receives the entries it has not seen yet, a new session catches up on the ones still in effect, and a session whose context was compacted gets them re-sent.
description.zh: 同一台电脑上多个会话共用的公告文件：一个只许追加的纯文本文件。每个会话在下一步之前收到自己还没见过的条目；新会话补看仍在有效期内的；上下文被压缩过的会话会收到一次重发。

description.en: Open the extension side panel and it takes over the page you are browsing right now. On top of upstream it adds: hover, coordinate clicks, drag, batched action chains, whole-page screenshots, local file upload, image listing, and switching between several connected browsers. Pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list; actions wait for your approval and sensitive fields s
description.zh: 打开浏览器扩展侧边栏，就能原地接管你当前正在浏览的网页。在上游基础上补齐了：悬停、坐标点击、拖拽、批量动作链、整页截图、本地文件上传、图片地址列举，并可在多个已连接的浏览器之间切换。页面以带编号的结构化文本交给模型；动作默认需要你批准，敏感字段以掩码呈现。发布的是桥接插件，配套扩展在同一 Release 里。本项目是 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser 的 fork，原仓库：https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

description.en: Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes with half-life memory decay: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking, n-gram/embedding hybrid search, and an explicit weight-feedback loop — a native Cordis plugin, npm-installable as @eqman00003/knowlp-rag.
description.zh: Markdown 笔记的双知识图谱 RAG，带半衰期记忆衰减：前置依赖 + 相似关联双图（P/S-Agent 遍历）、段落级匹配、ngram/embedding 混合检索、显式权重反馈闭环——原生 Cordis 插件，npm 包 @eqman00003/knowlp-rag。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Multisim MCP for circuit generation, simulation, diagnostics, design optimization, and experiment report export.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Multisim MCP，用于生成电路、运行仿真、诊断与优化设计，并导出实验报告。

description.en: Low-token web search that returns only {title, url, snippet} per hit — vendor extras such as answer, score and raw_content never enter the context. Five interchangeable backends (Tavily, Brave, SearXNG, Google CSE, Exa) with automatic failover to the next usable one in fallback / chain order when the primary fails, deduplicating repeated providers. Returned URLs and snippets are sanitized of track
description.zh: 低 Token 联网搜索：只把结果裁成 {title, url, snippet} 三个字段返回，厂商附带的 answer / score / raw_content 等一律不进上下文。后端可在 Tavily、Brave、SearXNG、Google CSE、Exa 五种之间配置，主后端失败时按 fallback / chain 顺序自动切换到下一个可用后端（同一后端去重）。返回的 URL 与摘要经清洗，除去跟踪参数。

description.en: In-app plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, one-click install, compat badges.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 内置插件商店：浏览、搜索、一键安装、兼容性徽章。

description.en: Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding, and exposes graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config tools plus a graphlint skill to DSH agents.
description.zh: 面向 AI 生成代码的死代码检测：graphlint 构建依赖图，定位从任何入口不可达的代码，以实现代码库清理和功能有效性理解，并为 DSH 智能体提供 graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config 工具与 graphlint 技能。

description.en: Fifteen curated theme families and nine complete dsh-web-ui skin replicas in one plugin behind a single settings entry, with CSS-only custom theme JSON, controlled custom skin-pack import via folder picker, preview, apply, delete and restore-default. Ships on npm as `dsh-appearance-gallery`.
description.zh: 15 个精选主题家族 + 9 个完整 dsh-web-ui 皮肤复刻合并为单一插件、设置页单一入口，支持 CSS-only 自定义主题 JSON、受控自定义皮肤包导入（可直接选文件夹）、试穿、应用、删除与恢复默认。npm 包名 `dsh-appearance-gallery`。

description.en: Registers a `deepseek-vision` provider route: the Web GUI accepts pasted images and transcribes them to text via the free Zhipu GLM vision API before delegating to the DeepSeek adapter.
description.zh: 注册 `deepseek-vision` 路由：Web GUI 直接粘贴图片，由免费智谱 GLM 视觉模型转译为文字后，再交给 DeepSeek 适配器作答。

description.en: Recalls prompts sent earlier in the current session with the up and down keys in an empty composer, and shows a position badge while browsing.
description.zh: 在空输入框里用 ↑/↓ 翻出本会话之前发过的提示词，翻动时显示位置角标。

description.en: Delete sessions with a 5-second undo and a recycle bin, plus an archive view to browse and unarchive, for the DSH Web GUI. Ships on npm as `@wsxwj123/dsh-session-manager`.
description.zh: 会话删除（5 秒可撤销 + 回收站）与归档视图（查看、取消归档）。npm 包名 `@wsxwj123/dsh-session-manager`。

description.en: Generates UI wireframes and high-fidelity mockups in DeepSeek Harness with selectable DashScope and Volcengine image providers.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用可切换的阿里云百炼与火山方舟图像服务生成 UI 线框图和高保真设计稿。

description.en: Adds a celebratory fireworks overlay to the DSH Web UI through a happy_fireworks agent tool.
description.zh: 通过 `happy_fireworks` Agent 工具为 DSH Web UI 增加庆祝礼花覆盖层。

description.en: Session-memory autopilot: watches DSH sessions and extracts OKF entries in-process through the harness LLM (ctx.llm, deepseek-official by default) at idle, commit, compaction and end checkpoints, storing them via the vault MCP server.
description.zh: 会话记忆自动驾驶：监听 DSH 会话，在会话结束与压缩前通过宿主 LLM（ctx.llm，默认 deepseek-official）就地抽取 OKF 条目，无需外部 API Key。

description.en: Injects a fixed system-reminder at the first step of every turn asking the model to reason and answer in Simplified Chinese, while code, commands, file paths, and identifiers stay in English.
description.zh: 每轮第一步注入固定的 system-reminder，要求模型用简体中文思考与回答，代码、命令、文件路径与标识符保持原文。

description.en: Model-facing `vision` tool for DeepSeek Harness: describe and OCR image files by calling the free Zhipu GLM vision API directly (glm-4v-flash fallback chain), no external CLI required.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型补上免费识图：`vision` 工具直连智谱 GLM 视觉 API 描述/OCR 图片文件（glm-4v-flash 降级链），无需任何外部 CLI。

description.en: Pre-install supply-chain checks for DeepSeek Harness plugins: verify the tarball you are about to install matches the source you read, before any code runs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件做安装前供应链校验：在代码运行前核对即将安装的包是否与你读到的源码一致。

description.en: Registers codex-web-search-mcp as native DSH MCP tools (mcp__codex-web-search__codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch) for model-independent Codex and Grok web search and deep research.
description.zh: 将 codex-web-search-mcp 注册为 DSH 原生 MCP 工具（codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch），提供与模型无关的 Codex / Grok 联网搜索与深度研究。

description.en: LLVM static-analysis plugin that builds whole-program bitcode for C/C++ projects and runs kernel-analyzer (KAMain) reachability analysis on it, providing kanalyzer_* tools to the agent and a ctx.kanalyzer service to other plugins.
description.zh: LLVM 静态分析插件，可为 C/C++ 项目构建整程序 LLVM bitcode，并在其上运行 kernel-analyzer（KAMain）可达性分析，向智能体提供 kanalyzer_* 工具，并向其他插件提供 ctx.kanalyzer 服务。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness integration for OpenContext with durable cross-session memory, automatic prompt capture and recall, session summaries, structured insights, and document retrieval.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenContext，提供跨会话持久记忆、提示词自动捕获与召回、会话摘要、结构化洞察和文档检索。

description.en: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server through koboldcpp_run and koboldcpp_vision tools, with on-demand server lifecycle management.
description.zh: 给在线模型装上本地双手：koboldcpp_run 与 koboldcpp_vision 工具把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地 KoboldCpp（llama.cpp）服务器，并按需拉起与管理服务器生命周期。

description.en: Local IMAP invoice download, OCR, archive, and Excel reimbursement summaries for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 IMAP 发票下载、OCR 识别、归档与 Excel 报销汇总。

description.en: Composer input toolkit: arrow-key session history (first/last-line gated, IME and command-menu safe), an instructions viewer/editor for global and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, and a prompt library of 780 Chinese prompts (Cherry Studio agents-zh corpus, AGPL-3.0) inserted into the composer in one click. Ships on npm as `dsh-composer-tools`.
description.zh: 输入框工具集：方向键调取历史消息（限首/末行触发，兼容输入法与命令菜单）、指令查看/编辑器（全局与项目级 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md）、提示词库（780 条中文提示词，源自 Cherry Studio agents-zh 语料，AGPL-3.0，一键插入输入框）。npm 包名 `dsh-composer-tools`。

description.en: Runs Midscene on the models already configured in DeepSeek Harness instead of separate third-party API keys: hosts an OpenAI-compatible bridge on 127.0.0.1 (default port 8787, automatically skipping occupied ports) that proxies chat completions, streaming and non-streaming, to the DSH host model layer, so DeepSeek official routing, CodeBuddy, Codex and custom OpenAI/Anthropic endpoints all become
description.zh: 让 Midscene 直接用 DeepSeek Harness 里已配置的模型，不再需要第三方模型 API Key：在 127.0.0.1 托管一个 OpenAI 兼容桥接服务（默认端口 8787，被占用时自动跳号），把流式与非流式的对话补全代理到 DSH 宿主模型层，DeepSeek 官方路由、CodeBuddy、Codex 与自定义 OpenAI/Anthropic 端点对 Midscene 全部可用；凭据留在各提供方插件内，桥不接触。`/v1/midscene-env` 端点直接生成四行 MIDSCENE_MODEL_* 环境变量并自动推断模型家族；浏览器、桌面、Android、iOS、鸿蒙自动化加 Vitest E2E 与 Midscene 知识参考共 7 个内置技能随装随用，无需 `npx skills add`。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web

description.en: Long-form novel writing plugin: each book is a git repository of frontmatter files, with 39 DSH domain tools and a web writing UI. Deep import drafts candidates, AI adoption into canonical assets requires DSH approval, and deterministic continuity checks ship with a report-only benchmark. Independent open source (MIT), not an official DeepSeek product; requires Node >= 24.11.0 and currently target
description.zh: 长篇小说写作插件：每本书一个 git 仓库，当前 39 个 DSH 领域工具 + Web 写作台；深度导入产候选草稿、AI 采用类写入正式资产前必过审批、确定性连续性检查（报告型）。独立开源（MIT），非 DeepSeek 官方产品；需 Node ≥ 24.11.0，当前适配 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1。

description.en: Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板中查看、添加、编辑、删除、启用或停用 MCP 服务器，保存后热重载。

description.en: Insurance company financial & operating analyst — solvency, financials, investment, distribution channels and peer comparison with real calculations.
description.zh: 保险公司财务经营分析专家，真跑偿付能力、财务报表、投资、渠道与同业对标测算。

description.en: Swaps the filesystem and bash providers for a mirage virtual workspace: file tools and shell commands run over mounted resources (RAM, S3, Redis, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Postgres) instead of the host disk, with per-mount read/write/exec modes, per-command sandbox routing (monty, pyodide, quickjs in process; docker, e2b, daytona remote), and installed CLIs (git, gh, slack, linear, ntn, gws, or one yo
description.zh: 把文件系统与 bash 提供者换成 mirage 虚拟工作区：文件工具与 shell 命令作用于挂载的资源（RAM、S3、Redis、Slack、Gmail、Notion、Postgres）而非宿主磁盘，支持按挂载点设置读/写/执行模式、按命令选择沙箱（进程内 monty、pyodide、quickjs；远程 docker、e2b、daytona），并可在虚拟终端中安装 CLI（git、gh、slack、linear、ntn、gws，或自行注册的程序树）作为命令头词。

description.en: Insurance company operations analyst — runs real solvency, profitability, embedded value (EV), investment risk and regulatory compliance calculations, not just text explanations.
description.zh: 保险公司经营分析专家（盈安），真跑偿付能力、盈利能力、内含价值(EV)、投资风险与监管合规五维测算。

description.en: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index.
description.zh: 将 LiuHe MCP 代码工具集（44 个工具）桥接进 dsh web：repo_map、符号搜索、带容错匹配的 edit_batch、带撤销日志的事务性编辑，以及确定性质量门禁——由崩溃隔离的 Rust tree-sitter 解析守护进程和 SQLite 索引支撑。

description.en: GitHub Device Flow connect plus an in-conversation PR workflow: a status bar above the composer for create / AI-review / merge, and github_* tools for search, issue and PR read and write.
description.zh: GitHub Device Flow 授权与对话内 PR 工作流：输入框上方的状态条支持创建 / AI 审查 / 合并 PR，另有 github_* 工具用于搜索、Issue 与 PR 读写。

description.en: Loopback-only ACP door for DeepSeek Harness: connect VS Code and other local clients to a running kernel over the local loopback address, sharing its models, tools, memory and sessions. Browse history, change permission modes and call capabilities registered by DSH plugins.
description.zh: 为正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 内核提供仅监听本机回环地址的 ACP 接入点，供 VS Code 等本机客户端连接，共用模型、工具、记忆和会话，并支持历史查看、权限切换及调用 DSH 插件已注册的能力。

description.en: Captures every plan the agent presents through exit_plan_mode as markdown under <workspace>/.dsh/plans, opens a review window, and keeps a Plans history tab recording the outcome of each plan.
description.zh: 将智能体通过 exit_plan_mode 呈现的每个计划捕获为 <workspace>/.dsh/plans 下的 markdown，打开审阅窗口，并以 Plans 历史标签页记录每个计划的结果。

description.en: Git Changes tab for the DSH web GUI: staging, diffing, AI-drafted commit messages, branch/merge/stash/worktree operations and sync, with live updates via fs.watch plus a changeToken poll.
description.zh: Git 更改标签页：暂存、对比、AI 起草提交信息、分支/合并/储藏/工作树操作与同步，通过 fs.watch 加 changeToken 轮询实现实时更新。

description.en: Merges other sessions' context into the current turn: evidence-weighted conflict resolution, retraction of claims whose premises were retracted, trust labelling that resists cross-session prompt injection, and budget-bounded packing. Ships a benchmark.
description.zh: 把其他会话的上下文合并进当前回合：按证据裁决冲突、前提被撤回时同步撤回结论、用信任格抵抗跨会话提示注入，并在 token 预算内打包。附带评测基准。

description.en: Adds a Managed Agents settings tab and MCP tools to dispatch long-running agent tasks to Ark cloud Managed Agents.
description.zh: 新增 Managed Agents 设置页，并通过 MCP 工具向方舟云端 Managed Agents 派发长任务、取回轨迹与产物。

description.en: Shared multi-agent task board (create/claim/transition/query) over a Cordis service key.
description.zh: 多 agent 共享任务板：经 Cordis service key 创建/认领/流转/查询任务。

description.en: Insurance actuary — runs real actuarial calculations (life & P&C reserve valuation under C-ROSS II BEL+RM, profit testing NBV/VNB/IRR, embedded value EV, pricing & loss-triangle reserving), not just explanations.
description.zh: 保险精算师（insurance-actuary）——真跑精算测算：寿险/财险准备金评估（偿二代二期 BEL+RM）、利润测试（NBV/VNB/IRR）、内含价值(EV)、产品定价与损失三角准备金，而非仅讲解。

description.en: Track the origin of local development ports on Windows and safely manage verified DSH services.
description.zh: Windows 本地开发端口来源追踪与安全处理工具。

description.en: Insurance product comparison & proposal expert — clause analysis, cost-effectiveness, coverage planning, generates verifiable client-facing PDF proposals.
description.zh: 保险产品对比与建议书专家（险析君），条款拆解、性价比测算、保障规划，生成可自核 PDF 建议书。

description.en: Block-addressed document editing: an MCP server exposing geml_get / geml_set / geml_check and friends, so an agent reads or rewrites one addressed block of a Markdown or GEML document instead of the whole file. Ships the GEML authoring skill and a code-graph skill that builds and navigates a project call graph as GEML codemaps.
description.zh: 按块寻址的文档读写：MCP server 提供 geml_get / geml_set / geml_check 等工具，Agent 只取回或改写 Markdown、GEML 文档中的某一个块，而不是整篇文件。另带 GEML 写作技能，以及把项目调用图构建为 GEML codemap 并浏览的代码图谱技能。

description.en: Directed fuzzing driven by an LLM agent: from a target repository and a bug (CVE description, patch, crash trace, or file:line), it runs a PLAN, IMPLEMENT, EXECUTE, REFLECT loop in which the model writes Python input generators, until an input triggers the campaign's stderr-pattern oracle or the campaign stops.
description.zh: 由 LLM 智能体驱动的定向模糊测试：给定目标仓库和一个缺陷（CVE 描述、补丁、崩溃调用栈或 file:line），它运行 PLAN、IMPLEMENT、EXECUTE、REFLECT 循环，由模型编写 Python 输入生成器，直到某个输入触发该 campaign 基于 stderr 模式匹配的 oracle，或 campaign 停止。

description.en: An Obsidian-style knowledge base: ingest sources, let the LLM build and maintain an interlinked wiki, and ask questions grounded in it.
description.zh: 一个 Obsidian 风格的知识库：摄取资料，让 LLM 构建并维护互联 wiki，并基于它提问。

description.en: Keeps long DSH sessions alive when a model channel starts failing: daruma takes over after the in-box retry gives up, trips a self-healing circuit breaker on repeated 429/5xx or a terminal error, and moves the next request to another channel in your chain. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x hosts, including 0.2.1-rc.2 with verified failover and backup-management RPC. The backup can be picked in Settings
description.zh: 渠道开始失败时不让长任务中断：内置重试放弃后 daruma 接管，对连续 429/5xx 或终止性错误跳闸自愈断路器，把下一个请求切到链上的其他渠道。支持 DSH 0.1.x 与 0.2.x 宿主，含已实测故障转移与备用管理 RPC 的 0.2.1-rc.2。备用渠道可在设置页或输入框旁的面板挑选，两处即时同步；每次切换落盘成可审计的 JSONL 日志。切换只记入这份审计日志，不再写入会话内的提示行——宿主不认识的插件事件类型会让整段会话加载失败。

description.en: Per-project scheduled prompts run as fresh headless agent sessions, with one-time, interval, and cron schedules plus durable run history.
description.zh: 按项目调度提示词，在全新的无头 Agent 会话中执行，支持单次、固定间隔和 cron 计划，并持久化运行历史。

description.en: Self-evolving team memory as plain Markdown in git: a native Cordis plugin that registers 38 bare-name memory tools plus a prompt-signals section re-evaluated at every assembly, with RPE reinforcement, decay and sleep consolidation; shares one data repo with its Claude Code (MCP) and OpenClaw hosts; verified against DSH 0.1.0-rc.6.
description.zh: 自进化团队记忆，以纯 Markdown 存于 Git：原生 Cordis 插件注册 38 个裸名记忆工具，并按每次组装动态注入 prompt-signals 段；含 RPE 强化、衰减与睡眠巩固；与 Claude Code（MCP）、OpenClaw 宿主共享同一数据仓；已对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 实测。

description.en: DSH-side remote session driver for the dsh-overdrive chat gateway: exposes sessions, trajectory replay and tap-to-approve to Telegram / Discord / Slack / WhatsApp / Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom bridges. Requires running @dsh-overdrive/gateway alongside.
description.zh: dsh-overdrive 聊天网关的 DSH 侧远程会话驱动：把 Telegram / Discord / Slack / WhatsApp / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 企业微信 的会话、轨迹回放与一键审批接入 Harness。需配套运行 @dsh-overdrive/gateway。

description.en: Forwards a local dsh web UI to the public internet under a *.ds.hn subdomain (or your own self-hosted relay), gated by a login, with optional end-to-end encryption (PBKDF2 to AES-256-GCM).
description.zh: 把本地 dsh 网页通过带登录门禁的中继转发到公网 *.ds.hn 子域名(也可自托管到自己的域名),支持可选的端到端加密(PBKDF2 到 AES-256-GCM)。

description.en: Desktop-grade companion: browser native notifications for user questions and approval interactions, screen capture model tool, multi-agent tiling grid view, and lightweight Tauri desktop shell.
description.zh: 桌面级增强套件：原生提问/审批交互通知、屏幕截图工具、多智能体平铺网格视图与轻量级 Tauri 桌面外壳。

description.en: Adds a take screenshot tool plus two optional automatic capture points, putting the screen into the conversation as an image block; requires an image-capable model.
description.zh: 一个截图工具，外加两个默认关闭的自动截图时机。需要模型支持图片输入。

description.en: SSH workspace and operations for DeepSeek Harness: bind a server directory as a workspace whose fs/subprocess calls route to the remote host via cordis seam replacement, plus web terminal, file transfers, tunnels, cluster runs and host management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 工作区与运维：把服务器目录绑定为工作区，fs/命令经 cordis seam 替换透明路由到远端主机，并带 Web 终端、文件传输、隧道、集群执行与主机管理。

description.en: Bidirectional Hermes ↔ DSH bridge: import Hermes sessions into DSH, consult Hermes, and receive Hermes-dispatched tasks as a single Cordis plugin.
description.zh: Hermes 与 DSH 的双向桥接插件：将 Hermes 会话导入 DSH、咨询 Hermes，并以单一 Cordis 插件接收 Hermes 下发的任务。

description.en: Automated data masking tool based on national standards, automatically identifying sensitive fields like ID cards and phone numbers.
description.zh: 基于国家标准的自动化数据脱敏工具，自动识别身份证、手机号等敏感字段，支持完全匿名化与假名化分级策略，生成合规审计日志。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer plus spend per session, today, this month and all time, priced by a configurable time-of-day price table per currency (DeepSeek CNY/USD defaults included). Two read-only remote methods, no host routes, key read through the host credentials seam on every call, egress only to the configured provider origin.
description.zh: 侧栏脚注显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并按会话/今日/本月/累计统计花费，按可配置的分时价格表（按币种分表，内置 DeepSeek 人民币/美元默认表）计价。两个只读远程方法，无宿主路由，密钥每次经宿主凭据缝读取，只向配置的供应商域名出网。

description.en: Workspace-scoped Semgrep SAST tool for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Windows x64 runtime, structured bounded findings, cancellation and timeout controls, and user-approved sandbox escalation. Installs from npm as @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区内 Semgrep SAST 工具，提供托管 Windows x64 运行时、结构化有界结果、取消与超时控制，以及经用户批准的沙箱权限升级。npm 包名为 @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast。

description.en: Quantitative data quality scoring based on GB/T 36344-2018, providing auditable quality reports for data asset capitalization.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 36344-2018 国家标准，从规范性、完整性等六个维度对数据质量进行量化评分，为企业数据资产入表提供可审计的底稿。

description.en: Conversation and workspace undo: use the /undo timeline, session-header action, or message icon to roll back before any sent prompt; private Shadow Git snapshots restore files, the reverted turns stay out of model context, and Undo Rollback can recover mistakes. Includes archived-session management and per-tool colored cards.
description.zh: 对话与工作区撤销：通过 /undo 节点轴、会话头部按钮或消息下方图标回滚到任意已发送 prompt 之前；插件私有 Shadow Git 快照恢复文件，被回滚回合不会进入模型上下文，误操作还能“撤回回滚”。附带归档会话管理与工具卡片分类配色。

description.en: Reports DeepSeek Harness session activity to a self-hosted cc-monitor server, which surfaces Claude Code and DSH sessions as color-coded state cards in one web dashboard and pings your browser and Android app when a session needs attention.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话活动上报到自托管的 cc-monitor 服务器：Claude Code 与 DSH 会话以彩色状态卡片出现在同一个 Web 仪表盘中，会话需要关注时通过浏览器与 Android 应用通知你。

description.en: Evidence-first self-evolution controller: bounded Cordis candidate generation, one-shot real-Loader admission, Harbor evaluation, and a crash-resumable journaled lineage.
description.zh: 证据优先的自进化控制器：有界生成 Cordis 候选插件，一次性真实 Loader 准入，Harbor 评测，可崩溃恢复的日志化谱系。

description.en: Host-side connector for the DSH Mobile iOS app: dials a self-hostable WSS relay so the phone can reach the DSH sessions on this computer over 4G/5G, without a public IP or a VPN; the relay only authenticates and forwards.
description.zh: DSH Mobile 的电脑侧连接器：连上可自建的公网 WSS 中转，手机在 4G/5G 下即可访问这台电脑上的 DSH 会话，电脑不需要公网 IP 也不用组网；中转只做鉴权与转发。

description.en: Memory Lake as a persistent memory layer for dsh: memory_search, memory_remember, and memory_forget tools over the memorylake CLI, a session status line, and guided setup/diagnostic skills, sharing one ~/.memorylake identity and memory set with the Claude Code and Codex plugins.
description.zh: 将 Memory Lake 作为 dsh 的持久记忆层：基于 memorylake CLI 的 memory_search、memory_remember、memory_forget 三个工具，会话状态行，以及引导安装/诊断 skills，与 Claude Code、Codex 插件共享同一 ~/.memorylake 身份与记忆。

description.en: A conversational voice frontend Agent for dsh: speak naturally over ByteDance Duplex, delegate requests to background tasks, and hear their asynchronous results reported by voice.
description.zh: dsh 的对话式语音前端 Agent：通过 ByteDance Duplex 自然对话，把语音请求委派给后台任务，并用语音回报异步结果。

description.en: Superself's self CLI as model-facing tools (project context, work units, reports, decisions) plus a /self command — cross-session, cross-project project state kept outside the code repo.
description.zh: 把 Superself 的 self CLI 暴露为模型工具（项目上下文、工作单元、报告、决策）并提供 /self 命令——跨会话、跨项目的项目状态，保存在代码仓库之外。

description.en: Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked, and on agent/turn-stopping a claim whose latest receipt is stale, failed or has no readable result steers one more step naming the receipt and the files edited since.
description.zh: 为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。

description.en: Seven agent-preset modes for DeepSeek Harness, each with a fixed tool boundary, per-mode model routing and fast/deep omd_task delegation tiers, plus a plan-to-execute loop (/mode, /start-work, goal-backed /ulw) and a settings page that remaps models per mode and per tier.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 7 个 Agent 预设模式：每个模式固定工具边界、按模式路由模型，并以 fast/deep 档位委派 omd_task 子代理；含规划到执行闭环（/mode、/start-work、基于 goal 的 /ulw）与逐模式、逐档位重配模型的设置页。

description.en: Data lineage tracking tool, mapping the full lifecycle of data to meet source legality requirements.
description.zh: 数据血缘追踪工具，梳理数据从产生到流转的全链路，满足数据产权登记中的来源合法性审查要求。

description.en: Local image, voice, music and SFX generation plus transcription, with pinned identity: characters, animals, objects and actor voices are defined once and reused on every later call, degenerate output (a near-flat image, silent audio) is rejected instead of returned as success, and a generated line can be read back as text so a clone that swallowed its ending becomes visible. The engines unload whe
description.zh: 本地生成图像/配音/音乐/音效并听写，同一性锁定：角色、动物、道具与配音角色定妆定声一次，之后每次调用复用同一份参考；退化产物（接近纯色的图、静音的音频）被拒绝而不是当成成功返回；生成的台词可以听写回文字，好让吞掉结尾的克隆暴露出来。空闲时引擎卸载显存，生图与听写也可改指向任意 OpenAI 形状的 API 而不用本地 Vulkan 后端。

description.en: A /remember command that writes facts into the AGENTS.md instruction hierarchy dsh already loads, plus a Memory tab showing which instructions the loader kept within its byte budget.
description.zh: /remember 命令将事实写入 dsh 已加载的 AGENTS.md 指令层级，并配有 Memory 标签页，显示加载器在字节预算内实际保留了哪些指令。

description.en: Persistent SQLite session state, story memory and recall, repositories, and model-facing record tools for DSH roleplay plugins.
description.zh: 为 DSH 角色扮演插件提供持久化 SQLite 会话状态、故事记忆与回忆、数据仓库以及面向模型的记录工具。

description.en: Scene-awareness probe for DSH on macOS: a privacy-first, pull-model `look` tool that reads the frontmost non-self window (app info, AX title/selection, gated local OCR), plus a summon-hotkey snapshot captured the instant you press.
description.zh: macOS 场景感知探针：拉模型零轮询的 look 工具，读取最前非自身窗口（应用信息、AX 标题/选中文本、按需本地 OCR），支持召唤热键按下瞬间抓取快照注入对话。

description.en: Ships a skill about writing DSH skills - SKILL.md frontmatter and root precedence, how to phrase a description so it actually triggers, length and splitting rules, and an A/B check that the finished skill changes agent behaviour. The package also carries the checker the skill uses to validate a skill directory.
description.zh: 携带一份讲怎么写 DSH 技能的技能——SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 与技能根优先级、description 怎么写才会被触发、篇幅与拆分标准，以及「写完后怎么证明它真管用」的 A/B 验证。包里还带着供这份技能校验技能目录的检查脚本。

description.en: Semantic-layer analytics tool that uses curated table, column and metric metadata with Qdrant and Elasticsearch recall to generate, validate and execute MySQL analytical queries through the Xiwen service.
description.zh: 基于人工维护的表、字段和指标语义元数据，结合 Qdrant 与 Elasticsearch 召回，通过析问服务生成、校验并执行 MySQL 分析查询。

description.en: Mounts the hosted Exa search MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa tools, anonymous on the free tier or with your own EXA_API_KEY.
description.zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接接入托管的 Exa 搜索 MCP 端点（mcp.exa.ai）：web_search_exa 与 web_fetch_exa 工具，免费额度匿名可用，设置 EXA_API_KEY 可解锁更高限额。

description.en: Session health-check: mechanically mines session logs into structured problem tickets (retry loops, tool-error clusters, interrupted turns, token waste) over the official session-query seam; works standalone.
description.zh: 会话体检：基于官方 session-query 接缝，机械挖掘会话日志为结构化问题工单（重试环/工具错误簇/中断回合/Token 浪费）；可独立安装使用。

description.en: Floating ZenTao work center: a right-edge sidebar listing tasks, bugs and stories assigned to you, with drag-to-chat, original links and auto-refresh.
description.zh: 悬浮禅道工作台：右侧边栏展示指派给你的任务、Bug 与需求，支持拖拽到聊天、原始链接与自动刷新。

description.en: Bridge dsh session status to the cc-pet desktop pet bubble: thinking, tool calls, and completion in real time. Ships on npm as `dsh-pet-bridge`.
description.zh: dsh ↔ cc-pet 桌面宠物状态桥：把会话状态（思考中 / 读取文件 / 运行命令 / 完成）实时推送到桌面宠物气泡。npm 包名 `dsh-pet-bridge`。

description.en: Beautified archive-manager settings section listing archived sessions grouped by workspace, with a hover unarchive action and relative timestamps.
description.zh: 美化版归档管理设置页：按工作区分组展示归档会话，悬停即可取消归档，附相对时间显示。

description.en: Quote earlier content of the current session into the composer: select text in any message for a Quote pill, or type @ to pick a whole message; the quote travels as a native reference chip and is serialized into the prompt as a blockquote. Client-only, no host routes, no custom session events.
description.zh: 把本会话里更早的内容引用进输入框：在任意消息里划选文字出现"引用"按钮，或输入 @ 选择整条消息；引用以原生 chip 形式存在，发送时序列化为引用块进入 prompt。纯客户端，无宿主路由，无自定义会话事件。

description.en: Personal-experience memory for DSH: turns solved tasks into sourced problem cases with condition-scoped claims, recalls them into new tasks via hidden pre-step injection, and makes corrections/deletes cascade to future recall.
description.zh: 个人经验记忆：把真实解决过的问题存为带来源、可纠正、有适用条件的案例，新任务中自动召回复用，纠正与删除会级联影响后续召回。

description.en: Adds Token Market as an OpenAI-compatible model provider with DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3.
description.zh: 将 Token Market 添加为 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商，并提供 DeepSeek V4 Pro、Kimi K3 和 GLM-5.3。

description.en: AI provider runtime and configuration UI for shared credentials and embedding, reranking, speech, and image generation services in DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供共享凭据以及嵌入、重排序、语音和图像生成服务的 AI 提供商运行时与配置界面。

description.en: Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 反向隧道：通过 frp 把 `dsh --profile web` 发布到公网地址，目录选择器改用应用内浏览器，手机或远程机器可直接打开并管理工作区。

description.en: Self-evolution actuator: consumes problem tickets mined from session logs, synthesizes skill candidates (zero-code tiers by default) behind an eval gate with hold-out canaries, then promotes to project .dsh/skills with human confirm and deterministic rollback.
description.zh: 自进化执行器：消费会话日志挖掘出的问题工单，在评测门（hold-out canary 防作弊）下合成技能候选，人工确认晋级到项目 .dsh/skills 并支持确定性回滚。

description.en: Web access for DSH agents: fetch JS-rendered or protected pages as clean markdown, aggregated search across 14 engines, and stateful interactive sessions (click, type, scroll, eval, screenshot) against a hosted or self-hosted Rust browser engine. Every session returns a live view URL so a human can watch the agent browse and take over with the mouse.
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 的网页访问层：把 JS 渲染或受保护的页面抓成干净 markdown，聚合搜索 14 个引擎，并提供有状态交互会话（点击、输入、滚动、eval、截图），引擎可托管可自部署（Rust 单二进制）。每个会话带直播页 URL，人能实时围观 agent 浏览并用鼠标接管。

description.en: Runs AItelier pipelines from DSH over MCP: 39 tools (22 read, 17 write) to generate, run, inspect, edit, export and import multi-step SkillFlow pipelines. The steps execute in AItelier rather than in the DSH session and are polled by run_id, pause at engine-enforced checkpoints answered with answer_checkpoint, and leave per-step traces and step outputs to read afterwards; add_provider / map_model
description.zh: 从 DSH 经 MCP 运行 AItelier 流水线：39 个工具（22 读、17 写），用于生成、运行、查看、编辑、导出与导入多步 SkillFlow 流水线。步骤在 AItelier 中执行而不占用 DSH 会话，按 run_id 轮询，在引擎强制的检查点暂停并由 answer_checkpoint 应答，事后可读取逐步 trace 与各步输出；add_provider / map_model / edit_role 可把单个角色指向本地或更便宜的端点。随包附带 aitelier-pipelines skill。

description.en: Agentic roleplay for DSH with structured worlds, autonomous characters, persistent sessions, world authoring, speech, and image generation. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-agentic-roleplay#state to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供具有结构化世界、自主角色、持久会话、世界创作、语音与图像生成功能的智能体角色扮演系统。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-agentic-roleplay#state。

description.en: AI UI automation via Midscene — android_ui and web_ui tools that tap, type, query, and assert on a real Android device or an already-running Chrome through the ctx.midscene seam.
description.zh: 基于 Midscene 的 AI UI 自动化——android_ui 与 web_ui 工具，通过 ctx.midscene seam 在真实 Android 设备或已运行的 Chrome 上完成点击、输入、查询与断言。

description.en: Ships a skill that documents how to build, debug and publish DSH plugins - host and client package skeleton, developing a forked plugin inside a throwaway profile, publishing to GitHub and npm, and the pitfalls found while shipping them. Installing the plugin registers the skill.
description.zh: 携带一份技能，讲怎么开发、调试、发布 DSH 插件——host/client 双半包骨架、把 fork 挂进丢弃式 profile 开发、发布到 GitHub 与 npm，以及发布过程中实际踩到的坑。安装插件即注册该技能。

description.en: Portrait layout for desktop windows: navigation takes the full left column, the file/terminal panel moves above the conversation, and a draggable splitter sets its height; touch devices are unaffected.
description.zh: 竖屏布局：电脑竖屏窗口下，导航占左列整高，文件/终端面板移到对话区上方，中间的分隔线可拖拽调整高度；手机/平板不受影响。

description.en: Registers the commercial-ui-ux skill for DSH: task-aware commercial UI/UX/GUI design, review, repair, and implementation (SaaS, dashboards, admin panels, forms, tables, design systems) with a reference-doc system and quality gates.
description.zh: 注册 commercial-ui-ux 技能：以任务为中心的商业界面 UI/UX/GUI 设计、审查、修复与实现（SaaS、仪表盘、后台、表单、表格、设计系统），带参考文档体系与质量门禁。

description.en: Vision MCP and DSH bundle for text-only DeepSeek: analyze_image, analyze_clipboard, compare_images and vision_status tools, a visual settings page, free GLM-4.6V-Flash by default, result caching and rate-limit tolerance; keys stay out of logs.
description.zh: 面向纯文本 DeepSeek 的视觉 MCP + DSH 插件：analyze_image / analyze_clipboard / compare_images / vision_status 四个工具、可视化配置页、默认免费 GLM-4.6V-Flash、结果缓存与限流容错，Key 不入日志。

description.en: Hosted tool server over MCP: invoice and bank-statement extraction with in-code arithmetic checks, ledger reconciliation in integer cents, PDF and table conversion, SQL dialect transpiling, and mainland-China reachability probes run from a China Mobile network vantage point.
description.zh: 托管工具服务器（MCP）：发票与银行流水提取并做代码内算术校验、按整数分对账、PDF 与表格转换、SQL 方言转写，以及从中国移动骨干网实测大陆可达性。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Postiz over MCP: list connected social media channels, fetch per-platform posting rules, and schedule, draft, or publish posts to X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord, Slack, Telegram and more; adds a postiz workflow skill.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Postiz：列出已连接的社交媒体渠道、获取各平台发帖规则，并向 X、LinkedIn、Instagram、Facebook、Threads、TikTok、YouTube、Reddit、Bluesky、Mastodon、Discord、Slack、Telegram 等平台排期、存草稿或发布帖子；附带 postiz 工作流技能。

description.en: Manage the dsh service via `dsh --profile ctl`: systemd lifecycle (install, start, stop, restart, enable, disable, uninstall), persisted config, health probe and logs, plus shell completions and self-update.
description.zh: 通过 `dsh --profile ctl` 管理 DSH 服务：systemd 生命周期（安装、启停、重启、自启、卸载）、持久化配置、健康探测与日志，附带 shell 补全与自更新。

description.en: OpenAI provider for language models, embeddings, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and image generation in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入、文本转语音、语音转文本和图像生成能力的 OpenAI 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Ships a skill about handing work to subagents instead of doing it inline - which tasks are worth fanning out, how many to run at once, how to send them in parallel, and how to check what they returned instead of trusting the summary.
description.zh: 携带一份讲「什么该交给子 agent 做、而不是自己顺手做」的技能——哪些任务值得扇出、一次派几个、并行怎么发，以及子 agent 回来后怎么核对它真的做了什么，而不是信它的总结。

description.en: Anthropic provider using the native Messages API for language models in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 使用原生 Messages API 为 DSH 提供语言模型能力的 Anthropic 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: ServerChan3 (Server酱) push notifications when a turn finishes — title, model, project directory, git branch, status and a reply excerpt, with subagent filtering and fire-and-forget delivery.
description.zh: 回合结束时向 Server酱3 推送微信通知——标题、模型、项目目录、Git 分支、状态与回复摘要，支持子代理过滤，fire-and-forget 不阻塞主流程。

description.en: Reranking provider for Jina, Cohere, and compatible rerank APIs in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Jina、Cohere 及兼容重排序 API 支持的重排序提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Avernet's Bot Collaboration Network over WebSocket V2, with automatic onboarding, isolated agent sessions, tool-call events, and multi-bot routing tools.
description.zh: 通过 WebSocket V2 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Avernet Bot 协作网络，支持自动注册、Agent 会话隔离、工具调用事件和多 Bot 路由工具。

description.en: China hard-tech supply chain intelligence: 33-signal board, H1 earnings tracker, hit-rate track record and Q&A, via a remote MCP (mcp__cn_intel__*).
description.zh: 中国硬科技供应链情报：33 条信号看板、中报验证追踪、命中率记录与问答，通过远程 MCP 接入（mcp__cn_intel__*）。

description.en: Diagnoses current and saved DeepSeek Harness trajectories with AgentDebugX and opens structured reports in its dashboard.
description.zh: 使用 AgentDebugX 诊断当前及已保存的 DeepSeek Harness 轨迹，并在其仪表盘中打开结构化报告。

description.en: An MC-Fabric-style hook processor.
description.zh: 类似 MC Fabric 的 hook 处理器。

description.en: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when engines fail so a thin result set is not read as a thin web.
description.zh: 把 web_search 指向自建的 SearXNG 实例而非原生搜索路由：自动翻页直到满足 maxResults，并在引擎失败时报告覆盖不全，避免把稀少的结果误读成网上本就没有内容。

description.en: Registers the Inspiration Deck Workshop skill for DSH: local static HTML presentation decks (6 deck templates, 25+ layouts, 23 themes & motion showroom) with a validate + PNG/PDF export CLI and smoke tests, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 注册灵感演示工坊技能：本地静态 HTML 演示文稿（6 套 deck 模板、25+ 布局、23 套主题与动效展示馆），带 validate 校验与 PNG/PDF 导出 CLI 和 smoke 测试，零运行时依赖。

description.en: LocalAI provider for language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation with LocalAI-specific controls in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入、重排序、语音和图像生成能力及 LocalAI 专用控制项的 LocalAI 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Main-brain orchestration preset: delegation-first persona, root-session execution gate, and portable AI-LAW rule skill.
description.zh: 主脑编排 preset：委派优先的 persona、根会话执行门禁，以及可移植的 AI-LAW 规则技能。

description.en: Computer use through an external USB HID device: name a target in plain language, a vision model locates it in a cropped window screenshot, and a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 moves the real mouse and types on the real keyboard. 7 tools. Windows has window listing, per-window cropping and automatic window raising; macOS needs pyobjc and has neither; Linux is unsupported.
description.zh: 通过外接 USB HID 硬件做电脑控制：用一句话描述目标，视觉模型在裁剪后的窗口截图里定位，树莓派 Pico 2 驱动真实鼠标和键盘完成动作。7 个工具。Windows 支持窗口枚举、按窗口裁剪与自动抬窗；macOS 需 pyobjc 且不支持这两项；Linux 不支持。
