description.en: Serves the obra/superpowers skill catalog to the harness and injects its using-superpowers bootstrap as a persistent, compaction-safe system-prompt section.
description.zh: 向 dsh 提供 obra/superpowers 技能目录，并将其 using-superpowers 引导作为持久、压缩安全的系统提示区块注入。

description.en: Export DSH conversations as Smartisan Notes-style PNGs, or create and update Markdown notes in a configured account-scoped workspace.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话导出为锤子便签风格 PNG，或在配置的账号工作区中新建和更新 Markdown 便签。

description.en: One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.
description.zh: macOS 上 DSH Web 的一键启停启动器：前台/后台启动、停止、状态、防重复启动、自动打开浏览器，并可用脚本构建程序坞版 DSH.app。

description.en: Customer-machine access plugin for deepseek-harness-gateway: opens a single outbound WebSocket to the gateway and relays the machine local dsh web UI over that tunnel using pairing-code + HMAC auth, so no inbound port, port mapping, or public IP is needed.
description.zh: 客户机接入插件：以单条出站 WebSocket 连接网关，把本机 dsh web 界面经隧道转发给门户，配对接入码 + HMAC 认证；无需入站端口、端口映射或公网 IP。

description.en: Cross-agent monitoring board for local AI agent sessions (cursor-ide, claude, codex, copilot, kimi and dsh itself) with session timelines, and message injection behind a default-off two-phase confirmation gate.
description.zh: 跨 agent 看板监控本机 AI agent 会话（cursor-ide、claude、codex、copilot、kimi 及 dsh 自身），提供会话时间线，并可经默认关闭的两阶段确认门注入消息。

description.en: Tavily backend for the built-in web search: an in-process endpoint at 127.0.0.1:8787/v1 turns its requests into Tavily searches; up to 10 API keys stay in the DSH credential store, rotate per request and switch on auth, rate-limit or quota errors; a settings card manages keys, runs a test search and points web search at the endpoint.
description.zh: 为内置网页搜索提供 Tavily 后端：在 DSH 进程内提供 127.0.0.1:8787/v1 接口，把搜索请求转成 Tavily 检索；最多 10 个 API Key 存在 DSH 凭据库，按请求轮换，遇鉴权、限流或额度错误自动换下一个；设置卡片可管理密钥、测试搜索并一键接入网页搜索。

description.en: Draggable weather bar in the shell overlay with forecast and geocoding from Open-Meteo; the position persists across sessions.
description.zh: shell 浮层中的可拖动天气条，预报与地理编码来自 Open-Meteo；位置跨会话持久保存。

description.en: Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the app, and inline app rendering in ordinary chats.
description.zh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

description.en: TapTap Maker integration for DeepSeek Harness: bundled MCP tools, Maker workflow and feature skills, plus a packaged CLI path for project initialization and diagnostics.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 TapTap Maker 集成：提供内置 MCP 工具、Maker 工作流与功能技能，以及用于项目初始化和诊断的随包 CLI 路径。

description.en: Deep research as an agent mode: one reviewed loop that plans, researches in adaptive parallel rounds driven by the gaps the researchers themselves declare, synthesises a cited report and then reviews it adversarially, instead of a script the model rewrites per call. Questions the round budget never reached are named in the report rather than dropped.
description.zh: 把深度研究做成一种代理模式：一条经过审阅的固定循环——先规划，再按研究员自行声明的缺口进行自适应并行轮次，综合出带引用的报告，最后对其做对抗性审阅——而不是让模型每次现写脚本。轮次预算未能覆盖的问题会在报告中被逐一点名，而不是被悄悄丢弃。

description.en: Streams DeepSeek Harness sessions, messages, tool activity, and turn outcomes to a JARVIS Mission Control board with task status and human review.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话、消息、工具活动与每轮结果实时推送到 JARVIS Mission Control 看板，附任务状态与人工复核。

description.en: Cross-session event-cue memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts task/conversation cues and user language habits from every turn into a persistent global cue bank, then re-injects remembered context on topic-switch detection (keyword or vector matching).
description.zh: 跨会话「触点记忆库」插件：自动从每轮对话提取任务/会话级触点与用户惯用词，存入全局持久记忆库；检测到话题切换时重新注入相关历史记忆（关键词或向量匹配）。

description.en: Creates and inspects RecoWork local-agent-project workspaces through two bounded DSH tools and a web workspace card.
description.zh: 通过两个受限的 DSH 工具和网页工作区卡片，创建并检查 RecoWork local-agent-project 工作区。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SiYuan (思源笔记) desktop app: registers its note tools as mcp__siyuan__<tool>, exposes the AI configured in SiYuan together with its agent loop as one more tool, ships a notes skill, and enforces a readonly/authoring/full profile on every call while keeping the tool list available when the app is closed.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到本机思源笔记桌面端：把笔记工具注册为 mcp__siyuan__<tool>，额外把思源里配置好的 AI 与其 agent 回路也做成一个工具（按档位门禁），附带笔记使用技能，并在每次调用上执行只读/创作/完整三级策略；思源关闭时工具列表依然可用。

description.en: Word alternatives and underscore-gated fill-ins in the composer. End a line with _ and it is filled; misspellings are flagged as you type. Routes through the model dsh is already configured with, so it needs no API key.
description.zh: 在输入框内提供同义词替换与以下划线触发的补全：一行以 _ 结尾即自动补全，拼写错误在输入时即时标出。它走 dsh 已配置好的模型，因此无需额外的 API key。

description.en: Set an earlier automatic-compaction threshold per model on DeepSeek Harness: /autocompact writes a session-only override keyed by exact provider/model (off falls back to the backend defaults, default clears it), a Settings → Autocompact page manages the persisted per-model thresholds every session inherits, and a composer status entry shows the current reading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 按模型设置更早的自动压缩阈值：/autocompact 以精确 provider/model 为键写入仅本会话生效的覆盖值（off 回退后端默认、default 清除覆盖），设置页「自动压缩」管理所有会话继承的持久化逐模型阈值，输入框状态条目显示当前读数。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for IsingQ: guided QUBO modeling and validation on-device, then user-confirmed remote solving.
description.zh: IsingQ 原生插件：引导式 QUBO 建模与本地校验，用户确认后提交远端求解。

description.en: Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry, and anti-aliased text edges (lossless Flate write-back), via a single Python script (pypdf + Pillow + numpy).
description.zh: 注册 remove-pdf-background-gray 技能：去除扫描 PDF 的灰色/米白底色，保持分辨率、页面几何与抗锯齿文字边缘（无损 Flate 写回），核心为单文件 Python 脚本（pypdf + Pillow + numpy）。

description.en: Progressive tool disclosure: a deferred tool group costs one catalog line instead of its full schemas until the model loads it with tool_search, with one switch per group in Settings and each group measured against the live registry.
description.zh: 渐进式工具披露：被延后的工具组在每次请求中只占目录里的一行，模型用 tool_search 加载后才拿到完整 schema；设置页为每个组提供一个开关，各组开销按当前工具注册表实测。

description.en: Adds a "用量" section to the DSH Settings page that shows your MiniMax Token Plan usage (5h and weekly windows with reset countdowns), per-model breakdown, and video bonus credits; fetches `/v1/token_plan/remains` via a trusted plugin that holds the API key, auto-hides when no key is configured. MIT.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页「用量」section 展示 MiniMax Token Plan 的 5 小时 / 周窗口用量（带重置倒计时）、单模型明细与视频赠送额度；通过 trusted plugin 调 `/v1/token_plan/remains` 拿 key，未配置 key 时整段 section 自动隐藏。MIT。

description.en: Twelve curated palettes, eight accent colours, a contrast slider and font/scale overrides for the DSH web UI, with an inlined first-paint script that prevents theme flash.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 12 套精选配色、8 种强调色、对比度滑块与字体/缩放覆盖，并内联首帧脚本防止主题闪烁。

description.en: DSH-native integration layer for the Minta memory engine: composes the official dsh-mcp-client row, registers the minta-memory-governance skill plus a session-start memory prewarm, and ships a Minta agent preset; requires the separately deployed Minta engine (Python/Docker) to provide the 19 MCP tools - not usable without it.
description.zh: Minta 记忆引擎的 DSH 原生接入层:合成官方 dsh-mcp-client 行、注册 minta-memory-governance 技能与 session-start 记忆预热,并提供 Minta agent 预设;19 个 MCP 工具由需单独部署的 Minta 引擎(Python/Docker)提供,未部署引擎则无法使用。

description.en: Sends a desktop notification and chime when a DeepSeek Harness run completes, errors, or waits for approval, with a configurable duration threshold.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知插件：运行完成、出错或等待审批时发送桌面通知并播放提示音，支持可配置的时长阈值。

description.en: Runtime governor for DeepSeek Harness: zero-progress steering, generation-bound verification evidence, evidence-aware completion guarding, and task-profile tool restriction.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 运行时治理器：零进展回合引导、按代际绑定的验证证据、基于证据的完成守卫，以及按任务配置限制工具集。

description.en: Rewrites the Chinese copy of a market-installed plugin into English using a model already configured in the harness — automatically when the plugin is installed, then live-reloaded. Each file is translated in one whole-file pass, validated by a real parser where one exists (node --check for JavaScript, JSON and YAML parsers otherwise) and handed back to the model with the error for up to three rep
description.zh: 用你已经配置好的模型，把从市场安装的插件里的中文文案改写成英文——安装时自动运行，随后热重载。每个文件整体翻译一遍，凡是有解析器的都会实际校验（JavaScript 用 node --check，其余用 JSON、YAML 解析器），失败时把报错交回模型，最多修复三次；超过 48 KB 或始终无法解析的文件，回退到按行区间翻译，逐行与原文做结构比对。触发短语与本地化表可以选择保留而不翻译，未改动的原文件保留在同目录下的 .zh.bak。

description.en: Ships a skill plus six Node scripts for a DSH install that will not come up - walking the boot stages before readiness, the plugin dependency bridges and junctions under a profile, dead or duplicated plugin rows, and the upgrade path. The scripts are diagnostics first; the rebuild helper only writes when it is given --fix.
description.zh: 携带一份技能加 6 个 Node 脚本，用来处理装完起不来的 DSH——沿 readiness 之前的引导阶段、profile 下的插件依赖桥与 junction、失效或重复的插件行、以及升级路径逐段排查。脚本默认只诊断，重建脚本只有显式加 --fix 才写盘。

description.en: A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked against the non-routable ranges, with a streamed size cap and a content-type allowlist.
description.zh: ctx.web 接口的本地受控抓取提供方——dsh 自带完整的 web_fetch 工具，却没有随附后端。每一跳重定向都会重新解析并对照非公网地址段校验，另有流式大小上限与内容类型白名单。

description.en: Code RAG semantic index panel and settings card: live index bar with start/rebuild/cancel, plus one-click detection and configuration.
description.zh: Code RAG 语义索引面板与设置卡片：输入框上方的实时索引条（开始/全量重建/取消），以及一键检测与配置（Qdrant/Ollama/预设/ignore）。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks, including context injection: declare event, handler and outcome in YAML, where the handler is an in-harness tool (MCP included), a shell command or an HTTP endpoint, and the outcome is model-visible context, a denied tool call, or fire-and-forget.
description.zh: 以配置驱动的生命周期钩子，并支持上下文注入：在 YAML 中声明事件、处理器与结果——处理器可以是进程内工具（含 MCP）、shell 命令或 HTTP 端点，结果可以是模型可见的上下文、拒绝该次工具调用，或触发即忘。

description.en: In-place redaction and row-level rollback for session logs, preserving the seq-equals-row-index invariant that makes deleting a middle row corrupt the entire log. Originals are copied to a quarantine sibling before any write, and the reader's own semantics are replayed as a pre-write gate.
description.zh: 会话日志的原地脱敏与按行回退：守住「每行 seq 必须等于它的行号」这一不变式（删中间行会让整份日志打不开）。任何写入前先把原文复制成隔离备份，并以读取端自身的语义作为写前闸门。

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI themed as an XRY/B1 medical HUD: ECG heartbeat waveform and a rotating radar scan disc on the right bar, power-gen energy-cell meters on the left bar, a DATA TIMELINE scan-log table on the bottom, all in a cyan-on-near-black CRT skin around the original UI.
description.zh: 以 XRY/B1 医疗 HUD 为主题色的 eDEX-UI 风格 DSH 外壳：右侧 ECG 心电波形与旋转雷达扫描盘、左侧能量条仪表、底部 DATA TIMELINE 扫描日志表，青蓝近黑 CRT 皮肤包裹原始界面。

description.en: Infinite canvas for sessions, with regions bound to workspaces and agent presets, pinned session cards, sticky notes and alignment guides.
description.zh: 无限会话画布，区域绑定工作区与智能体预设，可钉住会话卡片、放置便签，带对齐参考线。

description.en: Identity-gated Tailscale access to the Web GUI with dsh still bound to loopback: a 127.0.0.1 proxy published by `tailscale serve` admits a request only when the Tailscale login it stamps is allowed, with an optional per-device allowlist, so the privileged /api methods behind the loopback check — Settings, Models, Plugins — answer without dsh being told to trust a remote host.
description.zh: 在 dsh 仍绑定回环地址的前提下，为 Web 界面提供基于身份的 Tailscale 访问：由 `tailscale serve` 对外发布的 127.0.0.1 代理，仅当其标记的 Tailscale 登录账号在允许列表内时才放行请求，并可另按设备白名单限制；这样受回环检查保护的特权 /api 方法（设置、模型、插件）无需让 dsh 信任远程主机即可正常响应。

description.en: Ecosystem infrastructure: a thin browser console for managing official repository plugins (zero patches) plus a make-dsh-plugin skill for guided plugin development.
description.zh: 插件生态基建：浏览器面板管理官方 repository 插件（0 patch）+ make-dsh-plugin 插件开发引导技能。

description.en: Turns a plain-browser DSH session into the WhaleHarbor lite client: a standalone browser --app window with a client-style top bar and task notifications, while the full desktop installer downloads in the background (multi-source, SHA-256 verified) and an install prompt appears when ready.
description.zh: 把浏览器里的 DSH 会话变成鲸港简版客户端：独立 --app 窗口、客户端顶栏与任务通知；后台多源下载完整桌面安装包（SHA-256 校验），完成后提示安装。

description.en: Self-learning loop for dsh: record lessons, draft and promote skills, periodic curator review that corrects, consolidates, and retires skills.
description.zh: dsh 自我学习闭环：记录经验、生成并发布技能，定期审查修正、合并与退役技能。

description.en: Preventive content policy for tool results: rewrites matched text, and drops or truncates whole fields by path before a result is normalised, rendered or persisted, so an unreviewed payload never enters it. Ships inert with no built-in category or domain blocklist.
description.zh: 工具结果的预防式内容策略：改写命中文本，并按字段路径整段丢弃或截断，让未经审查的载荷在结果被规范化/渲染/落盘之前就进不去。随包为真空操作，不含任何内置的类别或域名黑名单。

description.en: Skill provider that installs the whole @dennisrongo/skills catalog as one npm dependency, so skills install and update without cloning or linking directories.
description.zh: 技能提供者：将整个 @dennisrongo/skills 目录作为一个 npm 依赖安装，无需克隆仓库或链接目录即可完成技能的安装与更新。

description.en: Browse the GitHub issues and pull requests of a workspace's origin remote, filter and comment, close or reopen, and file one as a task on dsh-plugin-taskboard for an agent to claim.
description.zh: 浏览工作区 origin 远端对应的 GitHub issue 与 pull request，筛选、评论、关闭或重开，并可转成任务写到 dsh-plugin-taskboard 的看板上等 agent 领取。

description.en: Pool AI provider accounts per platform and route them through a local loopback proxy that bridges the OpenAI, OpenAI-Responses, Anthropic and Gemini protocols, then write the proxy into Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Grok, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes config files with snapshot-and-rollback safe writes; registers no agent tools.
description.zh: 按平台把 AI 供应商账号组成算力池，经本地回环代理路由并在 OpenAI、OpenAI-Responses、Anthropic、Gemini 四种协议间桥接，再用带快照回滚的安全直写把代理写进 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Grok、OpenCode、OpenClaw、Hermes 的配置文件；不注册任何 agent 工具。

description.en: Task kanban where agents claim and hand off work through taskboard_* tools, which cannot move a task to done or canceled — acceptance stays with a human.
description.zh: 任务看板，agent 通过 taskboard_* 工具领活与交接；这些工具无法把任务移到 done 或 canceled，验收由人来做。

description.en: Replaces the headless startup to add --model provider/model, --resume <id|latest>, --continue and --session-info flags to dsh headless runs.
description.zh: 替换无界面启动流程，为 dsh headless 运行添加 --model provider/model、--resume <id|latest>、--continue 与 --session-info 标志。

description.en: A thinking level stored per provider and model, so reasoning effort outlives the session it was set in and also reaches subagents, which dsh never asks. The in-session picker still wins, and a model with no row keeps its provider default.
description.zh: 按提供方与模型保存思考等级：推理强度不再只属于设置它的那次会话，还会应用到 dsh 从不询问的子代理。会话内的手动选择依然优先，没有配置的模型保持提供方默认值。

description.en: Security and governance for dsh: rule-based tool denial, full tool-call audit trail, and governance reports.
description.zh: dsh 安全治理：规则化工具拦截、完整工具调用审计轨迹与治理报告。

description.en: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-events: session-protocol events — auto session-start reminder + auto-save on session close; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools.
description.zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-events：会话协议事件插件——新会话入口提醒 + 会话关闭自动 save；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools 配套使用。

description.en: Code workbench in the right sidebar: a workspace file tree and a multi-tab Monaco editor with syntax highlighting and version-guarded saving, Tab completion from DeepSeek fill-in-the-middle, per-save checkpoints with rollback, codebase search (plus a codebase_search tool for the agent), and reference chips that insert a selection into the chat as an @path mention.
description.zh: 右栏的代码工作台：工作区文件树 + 多标签 Monaco 编辑器（语法高亮、版本守卫保存），基于 DeepSeek FIM 的 Tab 补全，按次保存的检查点与回滚，代码库检索（另提供 codebase_search 工具给 Agent），以及把选中代码以 @路径 mention 插入对话的引用胶囊。

description.en: Native A2A (Agent-to-Agent) server for dsh: expose this dsh as a callable agent over HTTP with JSON-RPC tasks.
description.zh: dsh 原生 A2A 服务：通过 HTTP JSON-RPC 将本 dsh 暴露为可调用的代理。

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI: system-telemetry left bar with per-core CPU sparklines, encom-globe world-map right bar with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer that follows the active workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 eDEX-UI 风格外壳：左侧系统遥测栏（含每核 CPU 迷你趋势图）、右侧 encom-globe 世界地图与上下行流量图、左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools: 15 schema-validated tools (memory + quality gates) plus an L0 guard of the consulting document-generation engine; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-events for the full session protocol.
description.zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-tools：咨询/汇报材料生成引擎的 15 个 DSH 原生工具（记忆面 + 质量门禁）+ L0 守卫；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-events 配套使用。

description.en: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation. Ships on npm as `dsh-turn-scrubber`.
description.zh: 右侧紧凑回合刻度条，悬停显示回合摘要，点击跳转到对应用户回合。npm 包名 `dsh-turn-scrubber`。

description.en: Web GUI enhancement bundle: a standalone password gateway with optional HTTPS for LAN and remote access, PWA install and icons, and desktop plus Web Push notifications, configured from a settings page.
description.zh: DSH 增强套件：为 Web GUI 提供独立的密码访问网关（可选 HTTPS，适合局域网/远程访问），整合 PWA 安装与图标、桌面通知与 Web Push，并在设置页统一配置。

description.en: Hacker News tools for feeds, discussion threads, search, and user profiles.
description.zh: 用于获取 Hacker News 榜单、讨论串、搜索和用户资料的工具。

description.en: Feeds every dsh prompt into the local agent-feedback-loop feedback-memory pipeline — captures dissatisfaction, reviews it offline into reflections, and attaches the compiled recurrence-rule context back to the turn, never blocking a prompt. Requires the agent-feedback-loop runtime; running agent-feedback-loop install afterwards wires existing dsh profiles automatically.
description.zh: 把 dsh 的每一轮 prompt 送入本地 agent-feedback-loop 反馈记忆管线——捕获用户不满、离线评审沉淀为反思，并把编译好的复发规则上下文附着回当前轮次，从不阻塞 prompt。需要先安装 agent-feedback-loop 运行时；安装后执行 agent-feedback-loop install 会自动接线已有的 dsh profile。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for rulemux: asks the local rulemux CLI for the rules rendered for this workspace (rulemux inject --agent dsh) and injects the output into the session at the first user turn, once per session. Nothing is written into the workspace for rules; skills are the only part that lands on disk.
description.zh: rulemux 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：通过 rulemux inject --agent dsh 取当前工作区渲染出的规则，在每次会话的首条用户消息时把输出注入一次。规则不往工作区写任何文件；只有技能会落盘。

description.en: Per provider/model generation concurrency, with a settings card: a cap on how many sessions may stream at once, enforced at the stream and again at subagent spawn, where a fan-out past the cap waits in a FIFO queue instead of failing.
description.zh: 按提供方/模型限制并发生成，并附带设置卡片：限定同时进行流式生成的会话数，在流式调用与子代理派生两处强制执行；超出上限的扇出会进入 FIFO 队列等待，而不是直接失败。

description.en: JARVIS-style sci-fi HUD shell over the DSH web GUI: electric-cyan VITAL SIGNS / RT-MONITOR / RT-LOG left bar, POWER CORE gauges and a rotating RADAR scan disc on the right with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer with a JARVIS header strip that follows the active workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 JARVIS 风格科幻 HUD 外壳：电光青色 VITAL SIGNS 生命体征 / RT-MONITOR 实时监控 / RT-LOG 事件日志左栏，右侧 POWER CORE 能源核心仪表、旋转扫描的 RADAR 雷达盘与上下行流量图，左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及带 JARVIS 头部横幅、跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: Token-authenticated REST and SSE bridge with QR pairing, so a phone app can read sessions, send messages and approve tool calls.
description.zh: 带令牌鉴权的 REST 与 SSE 接口，扫码配对后可在手机 App 上看会话、发消息、批准工具调用。

description.en: CapMap docs visualization with Obsidian-style semantic graph and capability panel.
description.zh: CapMap 文档体系可视化：Obsidian 风格语义图谱与能力面板。

description.en: Token usage and cost metering for dsh: per-session and aggregate statistics with configurable pricing and reports.
description.zh: dsh 用量计量：会话级与汇总 token 统计、可配置计价与报告。

description.en: Builds a Markdown knowledge base from your course materials, then drills you until every knowledge point reaches your target accuracy; each answer must include your reasoning.
description.zh: 从课程材料建一份 Markdown 知识库，然后出题刷到每个知识点都达到目标正确率；每题都必须写出思维链。

description.en: Continues numbered and bulleted lists in the DSH composer, so Shift+Enter after "1. item" starts a new line with the next marker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里写列表时，Shift+Enter 换行后自动补上下一个编号（1. → 2.）或项目符号。

description.en: Unofficial FreeCodeGo for DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek, Codex and Claude engines over one session and toolchain, with a 0-token free access channel for deepseek-v4.1-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash-free, glm-5.3-flash, grok-4.6, kimi-k3, nemotron-3-ultra-free, muse-spark-1.3, Qwen 3.8 Flash and mimo-v2.6-flash-free, plus a keyless private-key gateway.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 FreeCodeGo：DeepSeek、Codex、Claude 三套引擎共用同一条会话与工具链，并为以下模型提供 0 token 免费使用渠道：deepseek-v4.1-flash、deepseek-v4-pro、deepseek-v4-flash-free、glm-5.3-flash、grok-4.6、kimi-k3、nemotron-3-ultra-free、muse-spark-1.3、Qwen 3.8 Flash、mimo-v2.6-flash-free，另有零注册的私钥网关。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness lifecycle status, errors, and approval requests to a locally running OpenPets desktop companion.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的生命周期状态、错误与审批请求，桥接到本地运行的 OpenPets 桌面伙伴。

description.en: Agent persona management, agent memory, edit-and-regenerate for past messages: create and manage agents, each with its own identity, long-term memory, global memory and chat history.
description.zh: Agent人格管理，Agent记忆，历史消息编辑并重新生成：创建和管理 Agent，每个 Agent 有独立身份、长期记忆、全局记忆与聊天记录，历史消息可编辑后重新生成。

description.en: Runs the standalone opencode2api backend (jasonxu114514/opencode2api, Windows x64/ARM64, no Docker or OpenCode CLI) with DSH and on exit stops only the process it launched; its settings card installs, updates or rolls back the backend from checksum-verified GitHub releases, copies the initial admin password and syncs /v1/models into an opencode2api provider with context, vision and reasoning effor
description.zh: 随 DSH 启动独立的 opencode2api 后端（jasonxu114514/opencode2api，Windows x64/ARM64，无需 Docker 或 OpenCode CLI），退出时只停自己拉起的进程；设置卡片可从经校验和验证的 GitHub Release 安装、更新或回滚后端，复制初始管理密码，并把 /v1/models 连同上下文、视觉与思考档位同步到 opencode2api 模型提供方，运行中每 10 分钟重同步。

description.en: Imports the MCP servers Codex and Claude Code already declare as dsh mcp-client tools, links the skills of 22 known agent skill directories into ~/.dsh/skills as symlinks instead of copying them, and adds a Settings page that lists what was mounted, toggles each skill, and changes the source on a name conflict.
description.zh: 把 Codex 与 Claude Code 已声明的 MCP 服务器接入 dsh 的 mcp-client，把 22 个已知 Agent 技能目录的技能以符号链接（不复制文件）导入 ~/.dsh/skills，并提供设置页：列出本次实际挂载的服务器与技能、逐项启停技能、重名时改选来源。

description.en: Answers a hard question with a one-page visual HTML explainer: the model writes a short Markdown draft and the bundled dependency-free `am` CLI builds the layout, CSS and diagram coordinates. Vendors the upstream answer-me-with-html skill verbatim as a skill-only DSH bundle with no Host code.
description.zh: 把复杂问题回答成一页可视化 HTML：模型只写简短的 Markdown 草稿，随包附带的零依赖 `am` 命令行负责排版、配色与图表坐标。以上游 answer-me-with-html 技能原样内置，是纯技能的 DSH bundle，不含 Host 代码。

description.en: Composer prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: a button beside the model selector rewrites the draft through one auxiliary LLM call and writes the result back in place, with composer undo left intact; a /prompt-enhance slash command returns the rewritten prompt as a command result line without touching the draft; the enhancement call can be pinned to its own fast provider and model in the profi
description.zh: 输入框提示词一键增强：模型选择器旁的按钮把草稿经一次辅助模型调用改写后直接写回输入框，输入框撤销不受影响；/prompt-enhance 命令把改写结果以命令结果行显示、不改动草稿；可在 profile 补丁里为增强调用单独固定 provider 和模型；改写忠实原文，保留意图、语言与信息量，代码、命令与路径原样保留，不编造事实、不输出占位文字。

description.en: Prompt optimizer in the composer: rewrites the draft into an eleven-section analytical prompt using the conversation, workspace files and the session's selected model, with one-click undo.
description.zh: 输入框内的提示词优化器：结合对话历史、工作区文件与会话选定模型，把草稿改写为十一节分析式提示词，支持一键撤销。

description.en: Week-keyed personal memo service: stores entries in ISO-week tables, resolves week/month/quarter/year navigation from one period calendar, archives quarters, runs AI analysis and Markdown report export, requires an explicit force flag to edit a past week, and turns one suite-wide telemetry failure analysis into a GitHub issue report.
description.zh: 按 ISO 周组织的个人备忘服务：条目按周存储，周/月/季/年四种视图由同一份周期日历解析，支持按季度归档，提供 AI 分析与 Markdown 报告导出，修改非当前周需要显式确认，并能把整条插件套件的遥测失败分析整理成一份 GitHub issue 报告。

description.en: Task-list staleness guard for DeepSeek Harness: watches the session event stream and counts tool calls since the last todo_write; past a configurable threshold it appends one short notice before the next step, quoting the current list, so the model writes it back to the real progress instead of leaving a stale snapshot on screen. Pure prompt injection, no blocking and no data mutation.
description.zh: 任务清单陈旧度守卫：监听会话事件流，统计上一次 todo_write 之后又发生了多少次工具调用；超过可配置阈值时在下一步之前追加一条简短提醒，并附上当前清单内容，让模型把清单写回真实进度，而不是在界面上留一份过期的快照。纯提示注入，不阻断流程，也不改动任何数据。

description.en: Highlights answered ask blocks (question n/n answered) in the conversation with a soft card style; pending asks and other tool blocks keep their native look.
description.zh: 提问块高亮：把对话里已答复的「提问 n/n 已回答」工具块用柔和卡片样式凸显；等待中的提问块与其它工具块保持原样。

description.en: Thesis and empirical-analysis workbench that drives IBM SPSS from the conversation: spss_check (environment self-check), spss_variables (list .sav variables with labels, types, measurement levels, case counts), spss_data (sample case rows to inspect missing and outlying values), spss_run / spss_run_file (execute SPSS syntax or an .sps file, relative CD and GET FILE paths auto-rebased), and spss_an
description.zh: 论文/实证分析工作台：在对话里直接驱动 IBM SPSS。spss_check（环境自检）、spss_variables（列出 .sav 变量：名称/标签/类型/测度水平/案例数）、spss_data（抽查案例数据，检查缺失与异常值）、spss_run 与 spss_run_file（执行 SPSS 语法或 .sps 文件，自动修正 CD / GET FILE 相对路径）、spss_analyze（一键跑频数、描述统计、交叉表卡方、t 检验、单因素方差、相关、线性回归）。结果经 OMS 导出为结构化表格。自动探测 SPSS 25-31；内置 MCP server 为零依赖 stdio 服务。

description.en: GitHub issue service for DSH: turns a telemetry failure analysis into a uniform issue report, builds a pre-filled new-issue URL that is shortened when it would exceed a configured length budget, and rewrites a plain description into a structured issue with the deployment's model.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 GitHub issue 服务：把遥测失败分析整理成统一格式的 issue 报告，构造预填的新建 issue 链接并在超出配置长度时裁剪正文，再用部署配置的模型把一段自然语言描述改写为结构化 issue。

description.en: Reverse-engineering workbench: bridges a local IDA Pro into DeepSeek Harness through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, exposing the ida-pro-mcp toolset (decompile, xref, rename, comment) as mcp__ida__* tools. Auto-selects idalib headless mode (analyses a binary in-process, no IDA GUI) or GUI mode (connects to the IDA plugin RPC on port 13337). Adds re_check, re_open and re_status; the bundled MCP serve
description.zh: 逆向分析工作台：通过 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 把本机 IDA Pro 桥接进 DSH，将 ida-pro-mcp 工具集（反编译、xref、重命名、注释）以 mcp__ida__* 注册给模型。自动选择 idalib 无头模式（进程内分析二进制，无需打开 IDA GUI）或 GUI 模式（连接 IDA 插件 RPC，默认 13337 端口）。附带 re_check、re_open、re_status 三个工具；内置 MCP server 为零依赖 stdio 代理，任意 MCP 客户端可直接挂载。

description.en: Previews a workspace OpenWiki in the DSH Web right Sidebar: detects the wiki directory, serves it with the official `openwiki visualize` reader on a loopback port, and embeds it in its own tab, reporting the installed openwiki and DSH versions against configurable floors and checking the registry for its own updates.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右侧边栏预览工作区的 OpenWiki：识别 wiki 目录，用官方 `openwiki visualize` 阅读器在本地回环端口提供服务并嵌入自有标签页，同时对照可配置的版本下限报告 openwiki 与 DSH 版本，并向 registry 检查自身更新。

description.en: Injects the contents of a .keep-reminder file from the session working directory as a system-reminder, with three modes: once per session, first step of every turn, or every request.
description.zh: 把会话工作目录下 .keep-reminder 文件的内容作为 system-reminder 注入，支持三种模式：每会话一次、每轮第一步、每次请求。

description.en: Turns course, lecture, tutorial, meeting, and talk videos into structured study notes: it extracts the audio track with ffmpeg, transcribes it with Whisper, then writes notes with a chapter outline, emphasis markers, and a quick-reference card.
description.zh: 把课程、讲座、教程、会议、演讲等视频整理成结构化学习笔记：用 ffmpeg 提取音轨、Whisper 语音转文字，再生成带分段大纲、重点标记和速查卡的笔记。

description.en: Provides shared plan, context pickup, and progress update Skills through StateDock Remote MCP without executing tasks or scheduling agents; targets Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 通过 StateDock Remote MCP 提供共享计划、上下文恢复与进度更新 Skills，不执行任务或调度 Agent；适配 Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against morluto/rea over stdio, for reverse engineering anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥，经 stdio 连接 morluto/rea，让 agent 从应用行为一路逆向到底层原生二进制。

description.en: Multi-agent roundtable discussion: each member runs as a subagent on its own model and speaks in turn, a host summarizes each round, and termination writes meeting-minutes Markdown.
description.zh: 多智能体圆桌讨论：每个成员作为子代理在自己的模型上依次发言，主持人逐轮汇总，终止时生成会议纪要 Markdown。

description.en: Local-only telemetry service for DSH plugins: records operation trails and error events into a storage-domain KV table, applies a configurable redaction rule set before the write and again when the analysis reads back a record stored before a rule existed, and groups one plugin's failures by feature-code anchor, reporting the window it read, the route each group ran on, and the attempts recorded a
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件的本地遥测服务：把操作轨迹与错误事件写入 storage-domain KV 表，在写入前按可配置的规则集脱敏，并在分析读回早于规则存在的旧记录时再次按同一规则集脱敏，然后按功能码锚点聚合单个插件的失败事件，同时报告读取的时间窗口、每个失败组的模型路由，以及按写入顺序统计的最近一次失败之后的尝试次数。

description.en: NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek nodes inside DSH: five read-only tools covering provenance (both upstream releases this build names), a data directory's restored state and ledger audit, the conformance vectors, exact decimal conversion, and node reachability. Driving the node -- starting or stopping a daemon, depositing funds, sending bus messages -- is deliberately not exposed, because those are audit
description.zh: 把 NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek 节点接入 DSH：五个只读工具，覆盖版本与上游出处、数据目录恢复状态与账本审计、一致性向量、精确十进制换算，以及节点可达性探测。刻意不暴露启动/停止守护进程、存款、发总线消息这类在本项目里受审计的特权操作。

description.en: PWA icon: sets the icon (and manifest app name) used when the Web GUI is installed or added to the desktop; ships a default icon set and accepts a custom image.
description.zh: PWA 图标：把 Web GUI 安装/添加到桌面时使用的图标（以及 manifest 应用名）换成自定义内容，包内自带默认图标集，也可配置自己的图片。

description.en: Construction cost workbench for DeepSeek Harness projects.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 项目的工程造价工作台。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the AdWhispr remote MCP server through mcp-remote with browser OAuth sign-in, adding tools for competitor ad research, ad creative cloning, and launching and managing Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns. Requires an AdWhispr account.
description.zh: 通过 mcp-remote 加浏览器 OAuth 登录，把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 AdWhispr 的远程 MCP 服务：竞品广告调研、广告创意克隆，以及 Meta／Google／TikTok 广告的投放与管理。需要 AdWhispr 账号。

description.en: Let the DSH assistant send local, web, and AI-generated images directly to users in chat, with external vision support for text-only models. On Windows it runs through PowerShell.
description.zh: 让 DSH 助手把本地、网页和 AI 生成的图片直接发到聊天里给用户看，并为文本模型提供识图能力；Windows 下经 PowerShell 运行。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against CursorTouch/Windows-MCP, excluding PowerShell, FileSystem, Registry, Process and Scrape by default (16 of the 21 tools upstream 0.8.8 publishes). Requires uv on PATH.
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥接 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP，默认排除 PowerShell、FileSystem、Registry、Process、Scrape（上游 0.8.8 共 21 个工具，保留 16 个）。需要 uv 在 PATH 上。

description.en: Rotifer Protocol skills plus the Rotifer MCP server, configured as instances of DSH's own skill provider and MCP client: search Genes, compare them on Arena rankings, install or roll back Genes in the local project, and create and run local Agents. The MCP server is version-pinned and limited to its evolve tool set, which leaves out publishing and login.
description.zh: Rotifer 协议的技能包加 Rotifer MCP 服务，以 DSH 自带的技能提供器与 MCP 客户端实例的形式挂载：搜索 Gene、按 Arena 排名比较、在本地项目里安装或回滚 Gene，并创建和运行本地 Agent。MCP 服务锁定版本，只开放 evolve 工具集，不含发布与登录。

description.en: AI research toolkit for DSH: a model release radar, a per-model benchmark and community report from 13 structured leaderboards plus Chinese and English community discussion, and an AI news radar over 46 feeds and 22 official X accounts; registers four tools and three skills and renders every report to Markdown with a generated table of contents.
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 研究工具箱：模型发布雷达、单模型跑分与口碑体检（13 路结构化榜单 + 中英文社区讨论）、覆盖 46 个 Feed 与 22 个官方 X 账号的 AI 新闻雷达；注册 4 个工具 + 3 个技能，报告统一渲染为带目录的 Markdown。

description.en: Floating glass status bar for DSH on Windows 11 x64: an always-on-top capsule that mirrors session progress, the current step and pending approvals from a local DSH web profile, with peek and detail views; approval cards stay read-only until DSH returns its own decision receipt, and connecting to the official Desktop app is experimental and unverified.
description.zh: Windows 11 x64 上的 DSH 悬浮玻璃状态栏：常驻胶囊显示本地 DSH web profile 的会话进度、当前步骤与待处理审批，可展开速览与详情；审批卡在 DSH 返回正式回执前保持只读，连接官方 Desktop 应用属实验性、未验收。

description.en: Switchable backends behind the native web_search and web_fetch, chosen per session from a composer menu or /setup-search and /setup-fetch: DeepSeek, Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily, Tinyfish, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and server-side model search for search; local HTTP with a private-network allowlist, the DeepSeek Fetch API, Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily and Tinyfish for fetch.
description.zh: 为原生 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供可切换的后端，每个会话可在输入框菜单或 /setup-search、/setup-fetch 中选择：搜索支持 DeepSeek、Exa、Firecrawl、Tavily、Tinyfish、OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar 与模型服务端搜索；抓取支持带内网白名单的本机 HTTP、DeepSeek Fetch API 以及 Exa、Firecrawl、Tavily、Tinyfish。

description.en: Desktop only. DeepSeek Web in the Harness right Sidebar with synchronized theme, automatic launch, one-time web sign-in, and one-click question transfer.
description.zh: 仅 Desktop。把 DeepSeek 网页版放进 Harness 右侧栏：同步主题、自动打开、网页登录一次即可保持，并一键把提问带入当前对话。

description.en: Adds a red "Delete session" item beneath "Archive" in the sidebar session menu, with a custom confirmation dialog, for real session deletion — stops the session's running work, detaches its workspace, archive and pin accounting, removes its projection cache and log directory, then broadcasts removal so the row disappears at once, instead of only archiving it. Session deletion removes the conversat
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单的「归档会话」下方新增红色「删除会话」项，配自定义确认对话框，实现真正的会话删除——停止会话进行中的工作、摘除工作区/归档/置顶记账、删除投影缓存与日志目录，然后广播移除事件让该行立即消失，而不是只能归档。会话删除会把对话从磁盘彻底移除且无法恢复；删除会话与会话删除是同一种操作的两种叫法，搜其中任意一种都可以找到本插件。

description.en: Treats the session as a mainland-China user (zh-Hans-CN, Asia/Shanghai, ISO dates, CNY currency) and generates a self-consistent test persona: five tools, six cross-checks, GB 11643 check digit, phone prefix matched to carrier ASN.
description.zh: 把会话当作中国大陆用户（简体中文、Asia/Shanghai、ISO 日期、人民币），并生成彼此自洽的测试人设：五个工具、六项交叉校验，身份证校验位、号段与运营商 ASN、区划码与地址互相对得上。

description.en: DSH web plugin that browses, previews, restores and deletes archived sessions that were moved out of the sessions directory.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：浏览、预览、还原与删除已从会话目录搬出的归档会话。

description.en: Live session-title provider for dsh that regenerates the title after every user message, summarizing the most recent messages within a byte budget.
description.zh: DSH 会话标题实时生成器：每条用户消息后重新生成标题，在字节预算内概括最近几条消息。

description.en: Hides other memory plugins' context sections and tools inside a chosen DSH preset, so that session gets a clean context. Off by default; ships a read-only diagnostic tool.
description.zh: 在指定 DSH preset 里挡掉其他记忆插件的上下文段与工具，让该会话拿到干净上下文。bundle 形态、默认关闭，带只读诊断工具。

description.en: Tag-based skill filtering: attach tags to DSH skills, then hand each workspace or conversation only the subset its boolean tag expression selects (for example `pdf + docx` or `aegis * plugin`). Excluded skills are deny-shadowed out of the model catalog rather than merely hidden in the settings UI; skills outside the expression can still be added by hand or force-disabled, and the bundled `tagging-
description.zh: 按标签筛选技能：给 DSH 技能打标签，再用布尔表达式为每个工作区或对话选出下发给模型的子集（例如 `pdf + docx` 或 `aegis * plugin`）。命中以外的技能会被 deny-shadow 真正从模型目录里移走，而不只是在设置页隐藏；表达式之外的技能可手动添加或强制禁用，另附带 `tagging-skills` 教 agent 从本机技能清单自建标签体系。

description.en: Interior and exterior ballistics paper reproduction and code generation skill. Requires LibreOffice Kit for PDF rendering and a vision API key (e.g. Qwen-VL) for formula OCR.
description.zh: 内/外弹道学的论文复现与代码编写 skill。前置：LibreOffice Kit（PDF 渲染）+ 视觉 API key（如千问，公式 OCR）。

description.en: A machine-checked reasoning ledger: every fact must resolve to a real file:line and be quoted verbatim from it, every assumption must state what would falsify it, and a conclusion may not rest on an assumption that never comes back for review. The ledger can carry a review date, a confidence and a kill condition. Ships the checker tool, an /fp command family, an optional gate that asks before irre
description.zh: 可机械核对的第一性原理台账：事实必须落回真实的 文件:行 并逐字引用那里的话，假设必须写明什么情况下它错了，结论不得依赖一个永不回来复查的假设；台账可带复查日期、置信度与止损条件。附带校验工具、/fp 命令族、不可逆命令前的可选闸门，以及列出每轮修掉哪些错误码的面板。

description.en: Registers one agent tool, plugin_guard, that statically scans a DSH plugin package before it is installed and reports a verdict with the reasons: a missing or broken dsh.bundle.patch, a missing dsh.permissions block, install scripts, dangerous APIs and obfuscation, dependency risk, and source that is not indexed and therefore cannot be verified. Read-only: the scanned code is never imported, insta
description.zh: 注册一个 agent 工具 plugin_guard，在安装前对 DSH 插件包做静态扫描，给出判定与原因：缺少或损坏的 dsh.bundle.patch、未声明 dsh.permissions、安装脚本、危险 API 与代码混淆、依赖风险，以及未索引、无法核验的源码。只读：不导入、不安装、不求值、不运行被扫描的代码。
